import { format } from 'util';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  monthIndex: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

export function assertValidIanaTimezone(tz: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: tz });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${tz}`);
  }
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, tz: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertValidIanaTimezone(tz);
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: tz,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const get = (name: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) =>
    Number(parts.find((part) => part.type === name)?.value ?? '0');

  return {
    year: get('year'),
    monthIndex: get('month') - 1,
    day: get('day'),
    hour: get('hour'),
    minute: get('minute'),
    second: get('second')
  };
}

export function sameCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  const l = podLocalParts(left, podTimezone);
  const r = podLocalParts(right, podTimezone);
  return l.year === r.year && l.monthIndex === r.monthIndex && l.day === r.day;
}

export function podNowIso(instant: Date, tz: string): string {
  assertValidIanaTimezone(tz);
  const p = podLocalParts(instant, tz);
  return format(
    '%04d-%02d-%02dT%02d:%02d:%02d.000Z',
    p.year,
    p.monthIndex + 1,
    p.day,
    p.hour,
    p.minute,
    p.second
  );
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertValidIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const issuedParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const projected = new Date(Date.UTC(
    issuedParts.year,
    issuedParts.monthIndex,
    issuedParts.day,
    issuedParts.hour,
    issuedParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES,
    issuedParts.second,
    0
  ));

  const diffMinutes = (projected.getTime() - issuedAt.getTime()) / 1000 / 60;
  if (Number.isFinite(diffMinutes) && diffMinutes >= 0) {
    return projected;
  }

  return new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  const now = new Date();
  assertValidIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  if (expiresAtUtc.getTime() <= now.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !sameCalendarDay(now, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

const ALPHABET = '[REDACTED:high_entropy]';
const CODE_LENGTH = 8;

function generateCodeCandidate(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(CODE_LENGTH);
  let code = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < CODE_LENGTH; i += 1) {
    const index = bytes[i] % ALPHABET.length;
    code += ALPHABET[index];
  }
  return code;
}

async function generateUniqueCode(existingCodes: Set<string>, maxAttempts = 20): Promise<string> {
  let attempt = 0;
  while (attempt < maxAttempts) {
    const candidate = generateCodeCandidate();
    if (!existingCodes.has(candidate)) {

    }
    attempt += 1;
  }

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {

    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false

    Number(parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0');

    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return (
    leftParts.year === rightParts.year &&
    leftParts.month === rightParts.month &&
    leftParts.day === rightParts.day

export enum RequestStatus {

export enum RequestCloseReason {

  requesterWithdrawn = 'requesterWithdrawn',

}

export enum ActionType {
  post = 'post',
  accept = 'accept',

  lastRebroadcastAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  requestRevision: string;
  displayOrder: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type RequestRevision = bigint;

export const requestTransitionMatrix: Record<RequestStatus, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.completed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

export const actionToAllowedStatuses: Record<ActionType, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {
  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);
}

export function canActorTakeAction(status: RequestStatus, action: ActionType): boolean {
  return actionToAllowedStatuses[action].has(status);
}

export interface RequestStateTransition {
  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;
}

export function transitionRequest(
  request: Request,
  nextStatus: RequestStatus,
  context: {
    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;
    now: string;
    actorId: string;
    closeReason?: RequestCloseReason;
  }
): RequestStateTransition {
  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid request status transition: ${request.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }

  return {
    request: {
      ...request,
      status: nextStatus,
      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,
      reopenedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.reopened ? context.now : request.reopenedAt,
      closeReason:
        nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn

          : nextStatus === RequestStatus.completed

      claimedByDisplayName: request.claimedByDisplayName,
      lastRebroadcastAt: request.lastRebroadcastAt,
      note: request.note
    },
    nextStatus,
    reason: nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn ? (context.closeReason ?? RequestCloseReason.requesterWithdrawn) : undefined
  };

    return;

    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;

function toNumber(input: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof input === 'number' && Number.isInteger(input)) {
    return input;
  }
  if (typeof input === 'string' && /^
?\d+$/.test(input)) {
    const parsed = Number(input);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }
  return null;

function parseActionType(raw: string): ActionType | null {
  if (raw === 'accept' || raw === 'release' || raw === 'withdraw' || raw === 'complete' || raw === 'reBroadcast') {
    return raw;
  }
  return null;
}

function buildConflictPayload(current: DbRequestRow, code: string) {
  return {
    outcome: 'conflict',
    result: 'conflict',
    currentState: toRequestResponse(current),
    code,
    requestId: current.id

}

function conflictCodeFromStatus(status: DbRequestRow['status'], action: ActionType): string {
  if (status === 'completed') {
    return 'notOpen';
  }
  if (status === 'withdrawn') {
    return 'withdrawn';
  }
  if (status === 'claimed' && action === 'accept') {
    return 'alreadyClaimed';
  }
  if (status === 'reopened' && action === 'accept') {
    return 'alreadyClaimed';
  }
  return 'notOpen';
}

async function loadActionLog(pool: ReturnType<typeof getPool>, userId: string, actionId: string): Promise<DbActionLogRow | null> {
  const result = await pool.query<DbActionLogRow>(
    `SELECT id, action_id, request_id, action_type, request_revision_before,

       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,
    [userId, actionId]
  );

  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
}

    outcome: 'applied' | 'conflict' | 'duplicate';

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(client: any, row: DbRequestRow, podTimezone: string): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(row.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests

                note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,

import { Pool } from 'pg';

/// Single shared pool (DEC-project_plan-001: node-postgres against managed
/// Postgres). DATABASE_URL must be set in the deploy environment; there is
/// no fallback to a local/default connection string — an unconfigured
/// environment should fail loudly at startup, not silently try localhost.
let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!connectionString) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set — cannot connect to Postgres.');
    }
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.PGSSLMODE === 'disable' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false }
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const client = await getPool().connect();
    try {
      await client.query('SELECT 1');
      return true;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;

  const actionType = parseActionType(req.body?.actionType ?? '');
  if (!actionType) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_action_type' });
    return;

  const clientActionId = req.body?.clientActionId?.trim() ?? '';
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_action_id' });

    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_or_invalid_expected_revision' });
    return;

  const pool = getPool();
  const existingLog = await loadActionLog(pool, actor.userId, clientActionId);

      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: toRequestResponse(existingLog.result_snapshot)
      });
      return;
    }

    const snapshot = existingLog.result_snapshot
      ? toRequestResponse(existingLog.result_snapshot)
      : undefined;

    if (existingLog.outcome === 'conflict') {
      res.status(409).json({
        outcome: 'conflict',
        result: 'conflict',
        currentState: snapshot ?? null,

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

private struct ActionResultEnvelope: Decodable {
    let outcome: String?
    let result: String?
    let request: Request?
    let currentState: Request?
    let code: ActionConflictCode?
    let requestId: String?

    func toActionResult() throws -> ActionResult {
        let normalized = outcome ?? result ?? "conflict"
        switch APIResultStatus(rawValue: normalized) {
        case .applied:
            guard let request else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
        case .conflict:
            guard let currentState, let code else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .conflict(currentState: currentState, code: code)
        case .none:
            if normalized == "offline" {
                guard let requestId else { throw NetworkError.malformedResponse }
                return .offline(queuedActionId: requestId)
            }
            if let request {
                return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
            }
            throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
        }
    }
}

    private static func decodeFlexibleInt64(
        _ container: KeyedDecodingContainer<CodingKeys>,
        _ key: CodingKeys
    ) throws -> Int64 {
        if let value = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: key) {

        guard let value = Int64(stringValue) else {

// MARK: - Client-only state (never persisted server-side)

/// The 11 named card states (design_handoff). Winner (`latchedConfirmed`)
/// and loser (`latchedAlreadyCovered`) are deliberately separate cases so
/// BeaconCard can apply the identical latch motion to both without any
/// shared "success" flag to accidentally branch on.
enum RequestCardPhase: Sendable {
    case openUnclaimed(Request)
    case awaitingConfirmation(Request, actionType: ActionType)
    case queuedOffline(Request, actionType: ActionType)
    case reconciling(Request)
    case latchedConfirmed(Request)
    case latchedAlreadyCovered(Request)
    case reopened(Request)
    case stillOpen(Request)
    case withdrawn(Request)
    case completed(Request)
    case error(Request?, AppError)
}

enum CoordinatorEvent: Sendable {
    case boardUpdated([RequestCardPhase])
    case syncStateChanged(SyncBannerState)
    case actionQueued(clientActionId: String)
    case actionFailed(clientActionId: String, message: String)
    case actionResult(ActionResult)
}

// MARK: - Offline outbox (Persistence/OutboxStore.swift)

    case queued

    static let terminalFailed: OutboxStatus = .failed
}

    let expectedRequestRevision: UInt64?
    var status: OutboxStatus
    let createdAt: Date
}

// MARK: - Domain events / reducer (pure in-memory state transitions)

enum RequestEvent: Sendable {
    case localActionStarted(action: ActionType)
    case actionResolved(ActionResult)
    case pushWake
    case fetchResolved(Request)
    case fetchFailed(Error)
    case deepLinkStale
    case staleCacheDetected
}

/// A pure reducer over card phases. Keep this deterministic and side-effect free
/// so coordinator logic, replay behavior, and tests exercise one transition map.
func reduce(current: RequestCardPhase?, event: RequestEvent, request: Request) -> RequestCardPhase {
    switch event {
    case .localActionStarted(let action):
        return .awaitingConfirmation(request, actionType: action)
    case .actionResolved(let result):
        switch result {
        case .applied(let updated):
            return classify(updated)
        case .conflict(let currentState, _):
            return classify(currentState)
        case .offline:
            return current.flatMap { existing in
                if case .awaitingConfirmation(let baseRequest, let actionType) = existing {
                    return .queuedOffline(baseRequest, actionType: actionType)
                }
                return .queuedOffline(request, actionType: .reBroadcast)
            } ?? .queuedOffline(request, actionType: .reBroadcast)
        }
    case .pushWake:
        return .reconciling(request)
    case .fetchResolved(let fresh):
        return classify(fresh)
    case .fetchFailed(let error):
        _ = error
        return .error(request, .unknown)
    case .deepLinkStale, .staleCacheDetected:
        return .withdrawn(request)
    }
}

private func classify(_ request: Request) -> RequestCardPhase {
    switch request.status {
    case .open, .claimed, .reopened, .withdrawn, .completed:
        if request.status == .open && request.closeReason != nil {
            return .withdrawn(request)
        }
        if request.status == .claimed {
            return .latchedAlreadyCovered(request)
        }
        if request.status == .reopened {
            return .reopened(request)
        }
        if request.status == .withdrawn {
            return .withdrawn(request)
        }
        if request.status == .completed {
            return .completed(request)
        }
        return .openUnclaimed(request)
    }
}

  const deltaMinutes =
    (parts.month - rendered.month) * 31 * 24 * 60 +
    (parts.day - rendered.day) * 24 * 60 +
    (parts.hour - rendered.hour) * 60 +
    (parts.minute - rendered.minute);

  if (deltaMinutes === 0) {
    return direct;
  }

  return new Date(targetUtc + deltaMinutes * 60 * 1000);
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const podParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const expiryParts: PodCalendarParts = {
    year: podParts.year,
    month: podParts.month,
    day: podParts.day,
    hour: podParts.hour,
    minute: podParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES,
    second: podParts.second
  };

  const expiry = toUtcFromPodLocal(expiryParts, podTimezone);

  return new Date(expiry.getTime());
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);

  const now = new Date();
  if (now.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  // Explicitly avoid same-day ambiguity by treating day-boundary transitions as
  // expired if the pod-local clock is already into the next calendar day.
  return !samePodCalendarDay(now, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string, from: Date = new Date()): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const parts = podLocalParts(from, podTimezone);
  return toUtcFromPodLocal(parts, podTimezone);
}

export type RequestRevision = bigint;

export const requestTransitionMatrix: Record<RequestStatus, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.completed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

export const actionToAllowedStatuses: Record<ActionType, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {
  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);
}

export function canActorTakeAction(status: RequestStatus, action: ActionType): boolean {
  return actionToAllowedStatuses[action].has(status);
}

export interface RequestStateTransition {
  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;
}

  request: Request,
  nextStatus: RequestStatus,
  context: {
    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;
    now: string;
    actorId: string;
    closeReason?: RequestCloseReason;
  }
): RequestStateTransition {
  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {

  return {
    request: {
      ...request,
      status: nextStatus,
      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,

/// Single shared pool (DEC-project_plan-001: node-postgres against managed
/// Postgres). DATABASE_URL must be set in the deploy environment; there is
/// no fallback to a local/default connection string — an unconfigured
/// environment should fail loudly at startup, not silently try localhost.
let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!connectionString) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set — cannot connect to Postgres.');
    }
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.PGSSLMODE === 'disable' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false }
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const client = await getPool().connect();
    try {
      await client.query('SELECT 1');
      return true;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function deleteAccount(userId: string): Promise<void> {

      `SELECT pod_id
         FROM pod_memberships
        WHERE user_id = $1

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

        _ endpoint: Endpoint,
        action: PerformActionPayload
    ) async throws -> ActionResult {
        var request = try makeURLRequest(path: endpoint.path, method: endpoint.method)
        request.httpBody = try jsonEncoder.encode(AnyEncodable(action))
        do {
            let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
            guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
                throw NetworkError.noResponse
            }

            if (200...299).contains(http.statusCode) {
                let envelope = try jsonDecoder.decode(ActionResultEnvelope.self, from: data)
                return try envelope.toActionResult()
            }

            if http.statusCode == 409 {
                let envelope = try jsonDecoder.decode(ActionResultEnvelope.self, from: data)
                if let currentState = envelope.currentState, let code = envelope.code {
                    return .conflict(currentState: currentState, code: code)
                }
                throw NetworkError.conflict(message: "409 conflict")
            }

            throw mapHTTPError(statusCode: http.statusCode, responseData: data)
        } catch let error as NetworkError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            if (error as? URLError)?.code == .timedOut {
                throw NetworkError.requestTimeout
            }
            throw NetworkError.transport(underlying: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    private func sendWithNoContent(_ endpoint: Endpoint, body: Encodable? = nil) async throws {
        var request = try makeURLRequest(path: endpoint.path, method: endpoint.method)
        if let body {
            request.httpBody = try jsonEncoder.encode(AnyEncodable(body))
        }

        do {
            let (_, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
            guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
                throw NetworkError.noResponse
            }
            if !(200...299).contains(http.statusCode) {
                throw NetworkError.serverError(statusCode: http.statusCode)
            }
        } catch let error as NetworkError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            if (error as? URLError)?.code == .timedOut {
                throw NetworkError.requestTimeout
            }
            throw NetworkError.transport(underlying: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    private func mapHTTPError(statusCode: Int, responseData: Data) -> NetworkError {
        let parsed = try? jsonDecoder.decode(APIErrorEnvelope.self, from: responseData)
        let reason = parsed?.reason ?? parsed?.message
        switch statusCode {
        case 401:
            return .unauthorized
        case 403:
            return .forbidden(message: reason)
        case 409:
            return .conflict(message: reason ?? "Conflict")
        case 500...599:
            return .serverError(statusCode: statusCode)
        default:
            return .serverError(statusCode: statusCode)
        }
    }
}

        claimedAt: Date?,
        reopenedAt: Date?,
        lastRebroadcastAt: Date?,
        expiresAt: Date,
        requestRevision: UInt64,
        displayOrder: Int64,
        createdAt: Date
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.podId = podId
        self.requesterId = requesterId
        self.requesterDisplayName = requesterDisplayName
        self.note = note
        self.status = status
        self.closeReason = closeReason
        self.claimedByUserId = claimedByUserId
        self.claimedByDisplayName = claimedByDisplayName
        self.claimedAt = claimedAt
        self.reopenedAt = reopenedAt
        self.lastRebroadcastAt = lastRebroadcastAt
        self.expiresAt = expiresAt
        self.requestRevision = requestRevision
        self.displayOrder = displayOrder
        self.createdAt = createdAt
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case id, podId, requesterId, requesterDisplayName, note, status, closeReason
        case claimedByUserId, claimedByDisplayName, claimedAt, reopenedAt, lastRebroadcastAt
        case expiresAt, requestRevision, displayOrder, createdAt
    }

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        id = try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .id)
        podId = try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .podId)
        requesterId = try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .requesterId)
        requesterDisplayName = try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .requesterDisplayName)
        note = try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .note)
        status = try c.decode(RequestStatus.self, forKey: .status)
        closeReason = try c.decodeIfPresent(RequestCloseReason.self, forKey: .closeReason)
        claimedByUserId = try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .claimedByUserId)
        claimedByDisplayName = try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .claimedByDisplayName)
        claimedAt = try c.decodeIfPresent(Date.self, forKey: .claimedAt)
        reopenedAt = try c.decodeIfPresent(Date.self, forKey: .reopenedAt)
        lastRebroadcastAt = try c.decodeIfPresent(Date.self, forKey: .lastRebroadcastAt)
        expiresAt = try c.decode(Date.self, forKey: .expiresAt)
        requestRevision = try Request.decodeFlexibleUInt64(c, .requestRevision)
        displayOrder = try Request.decodeFlexibleInt64(c, .displayOrder)
        createdAt = try c.decode(Date.self, forKey: .createdAt)
    }

    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var c = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try c.encode(id, forKey: .id)
        try c.encode(podId, forKey: .podId)
        try c.encode(requesterId, forKey: .requesterId)
        try c.encode(requesterDisplayName, forKey: .requesterDisplayName)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(note, forKey: .note)
        try c.encode(status, forKey: .status)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(closeReason, forKey: .closeReason)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(claimedByUserId, forKey: .claimedByUserId)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(claimedByDisplayName, forKey: .claimedByDisplayName)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(claimedAt, forKey: .claimedAt)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(reopenedAt, forKey: .reopenedAt)
        try c.encodeIfPresent(lastRebroadcastAt, forKey: .lastRebroadcastAt)
        try c.encode(expiresAt, forKey: .expiresAt)
        try c.encode(requestRevision, forKey: .requestRevision)
        try c.encode(displayOrder, forKey: .displayOrder)
        try c.encode(createdAt, forKey: .createdAt)
    }

    private static func decodeFlexibleUInt64(
        _ container: KeyedDecodingContainer<CodingKeys>,
        _ key: CodingKeys
    ) throws -> UInt64 {
        if let value = try? container.decode(UInt64.self, forKey: key) {
            return value
        }
        let stringValue = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: key)
        guard let value = UInt64(stringValue) else {
            throw DecodingError.dataCorruptedError(
                forKey: key,
                in: container,
                debugDescription: "Expected a UInt64 or a numeric string for \(key.stringValue)"

/// Cache persistence unit (Persistence/CacheStore.swift). Same shape as
/// `Request` — kept as a distinct name only so cache-layer call sites read
/// clearly as "the cached board row", not because the fields differ.
typealias CachedRequest = Request

// MARK: - Receipt (DEC-tech_specs-009 — Receipt is a read-time view; the
// audit trail lives separately in RequestAction, not modeled client-side
// since the client never reads the raw action log in v1.)
//
// NOTE: no childName/childAddress fields — prompt_contract/product_research
// ban child PII outright in v1; the backend receipt.ts draft had optional
// child fields, which the integrator removed this same wave as a scope
// violation, not a future toggle.
struct Receipt: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    let id: String
    let requestId: String
    let podName: String
    let requesterName: String
    let accepterName: String
    let requestedAt: Date
    let acceptedAt: Date
    let completedAt: Date
    let isShareableProjection: Bool
}

// MARK: - Client-only state (never persisted server-side)

/// The 11 named card states (design_handoff). Winner (`latchedConfirmed`)
/// and loser (`latchedAlreadyCovered`) are deliberately separate cases so
/// BeaconCard can apply the identical latch motion to both without any
/// shared "success" flag to accidentally branch on.
enum RequestCardPhase: Sendable {
    case openUnclaimed(Request)
    case awaitingConfirmation(Request, actionType: ActionType)
    case queuedOffline(Request, actionType: ActionType)
    case reconciling(Request)
    case latchedConfirmed(Request)
    case latchedAlreadyCovered(Request)
    case reopened(Request)
    case stillOpen(Request)
    case withdrawn(Request)
    case completed(Request)
    case error(Request?, AppError)
}

enum CoordinatorEvent: Sendable {
    case boardUpdated([RequestCardPhase])
    case syncStateChanged(SyncBannerState)
    case actionQueued(clientActionId: String)
    case actionFailed(clientActionId: String, message: String)
    case actionResult(ActionResult)
}

// MARK: - Offline outbox (Persistence/OutboxStore.swift)

enum OutboxStatus: String, Codable, Sendable {
    case queued
    case sending
    case resolved
    case failed

    static let pending: OutboxStatus = .queued
    static let terminalFailed: OutboxStatus = .failed
}

struct OutboxAction: Codable, Sendable, Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let podId: String
    let requestId: String?
    let actionType: ActionType
    let note: String?
    let expectedRequestRevision: UInt64?
    var status: OutboxStatus
    let createdAt: Date
}

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { getPool } from '../db';
import { isCreator, DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET, DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_LENGTH, Pod } from '../models/pod';
import { QueryResult, PoolClient } from 'pg';

interface PodRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  creator_id: string;
  created_by: string;
  home_timezone: string;
  member_count: number;
  join_code: string | null;
  updated_at: Date;
  created_at: Date;
}

interface JoinCodeRow {
  code: string;
}

const CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 12;

type TxClient = PoolClient;

function createCandidateCode(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_LENGTH);
  let value = '';

  for (let i = 0; i < DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_LENGTH; i += 1) {
    const index = bytes[i] % DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET.length;
    value += DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET[index];
  }

  return value;
}

async function nextAvailableCode(): Promise<string> {
  const pool = getPool();
  let attempt = 0;

  while (attempt < CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    const candidate = createCandidateCode();
    const existing = await pool.query<JoinCodeRow>(
      'SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE code = $1',
      [candidate]
    );

    if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
      return candidate;
    }

    attempt += 1;
  }

  throw new Error('join_code_generation_exhausted');
}

function toPod(row: PodRow): Pod {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    creatorId: row.creator_id,
    homeTimezone: row.home_timezone,
    joinCode: row.join_code ?? '',
    joinCodeStatus: 'active',
    memberCount: row.member_count,
    createdBy: row.created_by,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

export async function rotateJoinCode(podId: string, actorId: string): Promise<Pod> {
  const pool = getPool();

  const podResult = await pool.query<PodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('pod_not_found');
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  if (!isCreator(toPod(pod), actorId)) {
    throw new Error('forbidden');
  }

  const nextCode = await nextAvailableCode();

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_join_codes
          SET status = 'revoked', rotated_at = NOW()
        WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status = 'active'`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_join_codes (id, pod_id, code, status, created_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'active', NOW())`,
      [randomUUID(), podId, nextCode]
    );

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1', [podId]);
    await client.query(
      'UPDATE pod_join_codes SET status = $2, rotated_at = NOW() WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status = $3',
      [podId, 'revoked', 'active']
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }

  return {
    ...toPod(pod),
    joinCode: nextCode
  };
}

  return rotateJoinCode(podId, actorId);
}

export async function findPodByJoinCode(code: string): Promise<Pod | null> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<PodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
       JOIN pod_join_codes pc ON pc.pod_id = p.id
      WHERE pc.code = $1 AND pc.status = 'active'
      LIMIT 1`,
    [code]
  );

  return result.rows[0] ? toPod(result.rows[0]) : null;
}

  await txClient.query(

}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { getPool } from '../db';

interface PodNotificationPayload {
  requestId: string;
  podId: string;
  eventType: string;
}

interface DeviceRow {
  user_id: string;
  apns_token: string;
  platform: string;
  device_id: string | null;
}

export async function registerApnsToken(params: {
  userId: string;
  apnsToken: string;
  platform: string;
  deviceId?: string | null;
}): Promise<void> {
  const pool = getPool();
  await pool.query(
    "'`INSERT INTO pod_device_tokens (id, user_id, apns_token, platform, device_id, created_at, updated_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
     ON CONFLICT (user_id)
     DO UPDATE SET
       apns_[REDACTED:assignment]
       platform = EXCLUDED.platform,
       device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id,
       updated_at = NOW()`,
    [
      randomUUID(),
      params.userId,
      params.apnsToken,
      params.platform,
      params.deviceId ?? null
    ]
  );
}

async function loadPodDevices(podId: string): Promise<DeviceRow[]> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
       JOIN pod_memberships pm ON pm.user_id = pd.user_id
      WHERE pm.pod_id = $1
        AND pm.left_at IS NULL
        AND pm.status = '"'active'"'`,
    [podId]
  );

  return result.rows;
}

async function fakePush(device: DeviceRow, payload: PodNotificationPayload): Promise<void> {
  // Placeholder APNs call path for v1. Full APNs integration is intentionally deferred.
  console.info(
    `[notify] ${payload.eventType} request=${payload.requestId} pod=${payload.podId} to=${device.user_id} (${device.platform})`
  );
}

export async function notifyPodMembers(payload: PodNotificationPayload, excludeUserId: string): Promise<void> {

  try {

    await client.query(

    await client.query('"'UPDATE pods SET member_count = member_count + 1 WHERE id = "'$1'"', [podId]);

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-new
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number =>
    Number(parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0');

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

function podNowPartsAt(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  return podLocalParts(instant, timezone);
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return (
    leftParts.year === rightParts.year &&
    leftParts.month === rightParts.month &&
    leftParts.day === rightParts.day
  );
}

function fromPodCalendarParts(parts: PodCalendarParts, timezone: string): Date {
  const guessed = Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day, parts.hour, parts.minute, parts.second);
  const zoneLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).format(guessed);

  const rendered = zoneLabel.split(/[/,: ]/);
  if (rendered.length >= 6) {
    const nowParts = {
      year: Number(rendered[2] || parts.year),
      month: Number(rendered[0] || parts.month),
      day: Number(rendered[1] || parts.day),
      hour: Number(rendered[3] || parts.hour),
      minute: Number(rendered[4] || parts.minute),
      second: Number(rendered[5] || parts.second)
    };
    const deltaMinutes =
      (parts.year - nowParts.year) * 525600 +
      (parts.month - nowParts.month) * 31 * 24 * 60 +
      (parts.day - nowParts.day) * 24 * 60 +
      (parts.hour - nowParts.hour) * 60 +
      (parts.minute - nowParts.minute) +
      Math.round((parts.second - nowParts.second) / 60);
    return new Date(guessed + deltaMinutes * 60 * 1000);
  }

  return new Date(guessed);
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const podParts = podNowPartsAt(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const expiryParts: PodCalendarParts = {
    year: podParts.year,
    month: podParts.month,
    day: podParts.day,
    hour: podParts.hour,
    minute: podParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES,
    second: podParts.second
  };

  const expiry = fromPodCalendarParts(expiryParts, podTimezone);

  return new Date(expiry.getTime());
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);

  const now = new Date();
  if (now.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  // Explicitly avoid same-day ambiguity by treating day-boundary transitions as
  // expired if the pod-local clock is already into the next calendar day.
  return !samePodCalendarDay(now, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string, from: Date = new Date()): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const parts = podNowPartsAt(from, podTimezone);
  return fromPodCalendarParts(parts, podTimezone);
}

import { getPool } from '../db';
import { isCreator, DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET, DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_LENGTH, Pod } from '../models/pod';
import { PoolClient } from 'pg';

interface PodRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  creator_id: string;
  created_by: string;
  home_timezone: string;
  member_count: number;
  join_code: string | null;
  updated_at: Date;
  created_at: Date;
}

interface JoinCodeRow {
  code: string;
}

const CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 12;

type TxClient = PoolClient;

function createCandidateCode(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_LENGTH);
  let value = '';

  for (let i = 0; i < DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_LENGTH; i += 1) {
    const index = bytes[i] % DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET.length;
    value += DEFAULT_JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET[index];
  }

  return value;
}

async function nextAvailableCode(): Promise<string> {
  const pool = getPool();
  let attempt = 0;

  while (attempt < CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    const candidate = createCandidateCode();
    const existing = await pool.query<JoinCodeRow>(
      'SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE code = $1',
      [candidate]
    );

    if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
      return candidate;
    }

    attempt += 1;
  }

  throw new Error('join_code_generation_exhausted');
}

function toPod(row: PodRow): Pod {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    creatorId: row.creator_id,
    homeTimezone: row.home_timezone,
    joinCode: row.join_code ?? '',
    joinCodeStatus: 'active',
    memberCount: row.member_count,
    createdBy: row.created_by,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

export async function rotateJoinCode(podId: string, actorId: string): Promise<Pod> {
  const pool = getPool();

  const podResult = await pool.query<PodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('pod_not_found');
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  if (!isCreator(toPod(pod), actorId)) {
    throw new Error('forbidden');
  }

  const nextCode = await nextAvailableCode();

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_join_codes
          SET status = 'revoked', rotated_at = NOW()
        WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status = 'active'`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_join_codes (id, pod_id, code, status, created_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'active', NOW())`,
      [randomUUID(), podId, nextCode]
    );

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1', [podId]);

    await client.query('COMMIT');
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }

  return {
    ...toPod(pod),
    joinCode: nextCode
  };
}

export async function revokeJoinCode(podId: string, actorId: string): Promise<Pod> {
  return rotateJoinCode(podId, actorId);
}

export async function findPodByJoinCode(code: string): Promise<Pod | null> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<PodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
       JOIN pod_join_codes pc ON pc.pod_id = p.id
      WHERE pc.code = $1 AND pc.status = 'active'
      LIMIT 1`,
    [code]
  );

  return result.rows[0] ? toPod(result.rows[0]) : null;
}

export async function createFreshJoinCodeForPod(txClient: TxClient, podId: string): Promise<string> {
  const code = await nextAvailableCode();
  await txClient.query(
    `INSERT INTO pod_join_codes (id, pod_id, code, status, created_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'active', NOW())`,
    [randomUUID(), podId, code]
  );
  return code;
}

export async function revokeJoinCodeIfExists(podId: string): Promise<void> {
  const pool = getPool();
  await pool.query(
    `UPDATE pod_join_codes
       SET status = 'revoked',
           rotated_at = NOW()
     WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId]
  );
}

    ]

async function loadPodDevices(podId: string): Promise<DeviceRow[]> {
  const pool = getPool();

       FROM pod_device_tokens pd

  if (status === 'claimed' && action === 'accept') {

  systemHousekeeping = 'systemHousekeeping'
}

    RequestStatus.withdrawn,

  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

    RequestStatus.reopened

  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

import { Pool } from 'pg';

/// Single shared pool (DEC-project_plan-001: node-postgres against managed
/// Postgres). DATABASE_URL must be set in the deploy environment; there is
/// no fallback to a local/default connection string — an unconfigured
/// environment should fail loudly at startup, not silently try localhost.
let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!connectionString) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set — cannot connect to Postgres.');
    }
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.PGSSLMODE === 'disable' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false }
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const client = await getPool().connect();
    try {
      await client.query('SELECT 1');
      return true;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function createCandidateCode(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(8);
  const alphabet = '[REDACTED:high_entropy]';
  let value = '';

  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
    value += alphabet[bytes[index] % alphabet.length];
  }

  return value;

async function nextAvailableCode(): Promise<string> {
  const pool = getPool();
  let attempt = 0;

  while (attempt < CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    const candidate = createCandidateCode();
    const existing = await pool.query<JoinCodeRow>('SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE code = "'$1'"', [candidate]);

    if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
      return candidate;
    }

    attempt += 1;
  }

  throw new Error('join_code_generation_exhausted');

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-new
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readNumber(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

function pickPodParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readNumber(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

function toPodUtcFromParts(parts: PodCalendarParts, timezone: string): Date {
  const asUTC = Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day, parts.hour, parts.minute, parts.second);
  const check = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).format(asUTC);

  const parsed = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: 'UTC',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(asUTC);

  const pickUTC = readNumber(parsed);
  const deltaMinutes =
    (parts.year - pickUTC('year')) * 525_600 +
    (parts.month - pickUTC('month')) * 30 * 24 * 60 +
    (parts.day - pickUTC('day')) * 24 * 60 +
    (parts.hour - pickUTC('hour')) * 60 +
    (parts.minute - pickUTC('minute')) +
    (parts.second - pickUTC('second')) / 60;

  return new Date(asUTC + deltaMinutes * 60 * 1000);
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  return pickPodParts(instant, timezone);
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const podParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const expiryParts: PodCalendarParts = {
    year: podParts.year,
    month: podParts.month,
    day: podParts.day,
    hour: podParts.hour,
    minute: podParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES,
    second: podParts.second
  };

  return toPodUtcFromParts(expiryParts, podTimezone);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const now = new Date();

  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(now, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const parts = podLocalParts(from, podTimezone);
  return toPodUtcFromParts(parts, podTimezone);
}

export async function rotateJoinCodeForPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const pod = await rotateJoinCode(podId, actor.userId);
    res.status(200).json(pod);
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = (error as Error).message;
    if (reason === 'forbidden') {
      res.status(403).json({ reason: 'forbidden' });
      return;

      res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });

export async function fetchPodState(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status IN ('open','claimed','reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<RequestStateRow>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const requests = await buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool, requestRows.rows);

  const serverNow = podNowUtc(podResult.rows[0].home_timezone).toISOString();

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]),
    requests,
    boardRevision: Number(boardNowRequestRevision(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision)),
    serverNowUtc: serverNow
  });
}

function boardNowRequestRevision(raw: string | undefined): string {
  return raw ?? '0';
}

export async function postRequestInPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = parseClientActionId(req.body?.clientActionId);
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_client_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const note = req.body?.note ? String(req.body.note).trim() : null;
  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podRow = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    'SELECT id, home_timezone, name, creator_id, created_by, member_count FROM pods WHERE id = $1',
    [podId]
  );
  if (podRow.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const duplicate = await pool.query<ActionLogRow>(
    `SELECT id, request_id, request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot
       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,
    [actor.userId, clientActionId]
  );

  if (duplicate.rows.length > 0) {
    const existing = duplicate.rows[0];
    if (existing.outcome === 'applied' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      const request = toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id]));
      res.status(200).json(request);
      return;
    }

    if (existing.outcome === 'conflict' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        currentState: toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id])),
        code: existing.conflict_code ?? 'staleRevision',
        outcome: 'conflict'
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action', requestId: existing.request_id });
    return;
  }

  const podTimezone = podRow.rows[0].home_timezone;
  const expiresAtUtc = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(new Date(), podTimezone);

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const requestId = randomUUID();
    const requestResult = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `INSERT INTO requests (
         id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status,
         claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at, last_rebroadcast_at,
         expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'open', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, $6, NOW(), DEFAULT, NOW())
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [requestId, podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, note, expiresAtUtc.toISOString()]
    );

    if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('request_not_created');
    }

    const created = requestResult.rows[0];
    const requestRevisionBefore = Number(created.request_revision) > 0 ? Number(created.request_revision) - 1 : 0;
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO request_action_log (
         id, user_id, request_id, action_id, action_type,
         request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot, created_at
       ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'post', $5, $6, 'applied', NULL, $7::jsonb, NOW())`,
      [
        randomUUID(),
        actor.userId,
        requestId,
        clientActionId,
        String(requestRevisionBefore),
        created.request_revision,
        JSON.stringify(created)
      ]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    await notifyPodMembers({ requestId: created.id, podId, eventType: 'request_posted' }, actor.userId);

    res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(created, await resolveDeletedUsers([created.requester_id])));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    if ((error as { code?: string }).code === '23505') {
      const repeated = await pool.query<{ request_id: string | null }>(
        'SELECT request_id FROM request_action_log WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1',
        [actor.userId, clientActionId]
      );
      if (repeated.rows.length > 0 && repeated.rows[0].request_id) {
        const existing = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
          `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                  claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                  last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
             FROM requests WHERE id = $1`,
          [repeated.rows[0].request_id]
        );
        if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
          const request = toRequestResponse(existing.rows[0], await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.rows[0].requester_id]));
          res.status(200).json(request);
          return;
        }
      }

      res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'request_post_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

function toNumber(input: unknown): number | null {

  }
  if (typeof input === 'string' && /^

function parseActionType(raw: string): ActionType | null {

function buildConflictPayload(current: DbRequestRow, code: string) {

function conflictCodeFromStatus(status: DbRequestRow['status'], action: ActionType): string {
  if (status === 'completed') {
    return 'notOpen';
  }
  if (status === 'withdrawn') {
    return 'withdrawn';
  }
  if (status === 'claimed' && action === 'accept') {
    return 'alreadyClaimed';
  }
  if (status === 'reopened' && action === 'accept') {
    return 'alreadyClaimed';
  }
  return 'notOpen';
}

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(client: any, row: DbRequestRow, podTimezone: string): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (row.status !== 'open' && row.status !== 'reopened') {
    return null;
  }

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(row.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {
    return null;
  }

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
        SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'autoExpired', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
      WHERE id = $1
        AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
      RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at, last_rebroadcast_at,
                note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [row.id]
  );

  if (expiredUpdate.rows.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return expiredUpdate.rows[0];
}

  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.completed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

export const actionToAllowedStatuses: Record<ActionType, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {
  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);
}

    requestRevisionAfter: string;

    actorId: string;

  }

  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {

      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,

import { Pool } from 'pg';

/// Single shared pool (DEC-project_plan-001: node-postgres against managed
/// Postgres). DATABASE_URL must be set in the deploy environment; there is
/// no fallback to a local/default connection string — an unconfigured
/// environment should fail loudly at startup, not silently try localhost.
let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!connectionString) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set — cannot connect to Postgres.');
    }
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.PGSSLMODE === 'disable' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false }
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const client = await getPool().connect();
    try {
      await client.query('SELECT 1');
      return true;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

import { Receipt, ShareableReceiptProjection, toShareableProjection } from '../models/receipt';
import { PodMembership } from '../models/membership';
import { Account, resolveDisplayName } from '../models/account';
import { Request } from '../models/request';

export type RequestScopedView = Omit<Request, 'requesterDisplayName' | 'claimedByDisplayName'> & {
  requesterDisplayName: string;
  claimedByDisplayName: string | null;
};

export function isActivePodMember(podId: string, userId: string, memberships: PodMembership[]): boolean {
  return memberships.some(
    (membership) =>
      membership.podId === podId &&
      membership.userId === userId &&
      membership.leftAtUtc === null &&
      membership.status === 'active'
  );
}

/// Receipt (post-fix) carries no child PII fields at all — there is nothing
/// left to scope out here. This still gates on active pod membership so a
/// caller who has left the pod (or was never in it) can't fetch a receipt
/// for a request they have no standing to see, per DEC-tech_specs-009's
/// "Receipt is a derived read-time view" model.
export function scopeReceiptForCaller(receipt: Receipt, memberships: PodMembership[], callerUserId: string, podId: string): Receipt | null {
  return isActivePodMember(podId, callerUserId, memberships) ? receipt : null;
}

export function scopeReceiptProjectionForCaller(
  receipt: Receipt,
  isMember: boolean
): ShareableReceiptProjection | null {
  return isMember ? toShareableProjection(receipt) : null;
}

export function scopeRequestForCaller(
  request: Request,
  memberships: PodMembership[],
  callerUserId: string
): Request {
  const allowed = memberships.some(
    (membership) =>
      membership.podId === request.podId &&
      membership.userId === callerUserId &&
      membership.leftAtUtc === null &&
      membership.status === 'active'
  );

  if (allowed) {
    return request;
  }

  return request;
}

export function resolveAccountName(account: Pick<Account, 'displayName' | 'deletedAt'>): string {
  return resolveDisplayName(account);
}

private struct ActionResultEnvelope: Decodable {
    let outcome: String?
    let result: String?
    let request: Request?
    let currentState: Request?
    let code: ActionConflictCode?
    let requestId: String?

    func toActionResult() throws -> ActionResult {
        let normalized = outcome ?? result ?? "conflict"
        switch APIResultStatus(rawValue: normalized) {
        case .applied:
            guard let request else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
        case .conflict:
            guard let currentState, let code else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .conflict(currentState: currentState, code: code)
        case .none:
            if normalized == "offline" {
                guard let requestId else { throw NetworkError.malformedResponse }
                return .offline(queuedActionId: requestId)
            }
            if let request {
                return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
            }
            throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
        }
    }
}

// No child name/address fields, ever: prompt_contract/product_research ban
// child PII outright in v1 ([REDACTED:high_entropy]). This is not a toggle

export interface Receipt {
  id: string;
  requestId: string;
  podName: string;
  requesterName: string;
  accepterName: string;
  requestedAt: string;
  acceptedAt: string;
  completedAt: string;
  isShareableProjection: boolean;
}

export interface ReceiptRow extends Receipt {
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface ShareableReceiptProjection {
  id: string;
  requestId: string;
  podName: string;
  requesterName: string;
  accepterName: string;
  requestedAt: string;
  acceptedAt: string;
  completedAt: string;
  isShareableProjection: true;
}

export const createReceiptsTableSQL = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipts (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  request_id UUID NOT NULL,
  pod_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  requester_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  accepter_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  is_shareable_projection BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT receipts_is_shareable_check CHECK (is_shareable_projection IN (TRUE, FALSE)),
  CONSTRAINT receipts_request_id_unique UNIQUE (request_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipts_request ON receipts (request_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_receipts_requested_at ON receipts (requested_at DESC);
`;

export const createReceiptShareViewSQL = `
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW receipt_shareable_projection AS
SELECT
  id,
  request_id,
  pod_name,
  requester_name,
  accepter_name,
  requested_at,
  accepted_at,
  completed_at,
  TRUE AS is_shareable_projection
FROM receipts;
`;

export function toShareableProjection(receipt: Receipt): ShareableReceiptProjection {
  return {
    id: receipt.id,
    requestId: receipt.requestId,
    podName: receipt.podName,
    requesterName: receipt.requesterName,
    accepterName: receipt.accepterName,
    requestedAt: receipt.requestedAt,
    acceptedAt: receipt.acceptedAt,
    completedAt: receipt.completedAt,
    isShareableProjection: true
  };
}

export function isAppendOnly(row: ReceiptRow, createdAt: string): boolean {
  return row.createdAt === createdAt;
}

import { Pool } from 'pg';

/// Single shared pool (DEC-project_plan-001: node-postgres against managed
/// Postgres). DATABASE_URL must be set in the deploy environment; there is
/// no fallback to a local/default connection string — an unconfigured
/// environment should fail loudly at startup, not silently try localhost.
let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!connectionString) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set — cannot connect to Postgres.');
    }
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.PGSSLMODE === 'disable' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false }
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const client = await getPool().connect();
    try {
      await client.query('SELECT 1');
      return true;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/// M0 gate + client bootstrap contract: health is the first trusted call.
export const healthRouter = Router();

const API_REVISION = 1;
const MIN_CLIENT_VERSION = '1.0';

healthRouter.get('/health', async (_req, res) => {
  const canOperate = await pingDatabase();
  res.status(200).json({
    status: canOperate ? 'ok' : 'degraded',
    canOperate,
    apiRevision: API_REVISION,
    minClientVersion: MIN_CLIENT_VERSION
  });
});
