       SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, requests.created_at, $6, $7, TRUE
         FROM requests
        WHERE id = $2
        ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING`,
    [
      randomUUID(),
      request.id,
      podName,
      request.requester_display_name,
      request.claimed_by_display_name,
      acceptedAt.toISOString(),
      completedAt.toISOString()
    ]
  );
}

async function resolveByAction(
  client: any,
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  action: ActionType,
  actor: { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string },
  expectedRequestRevision: string
): Promise<ActionResultRequest> {
  const now = new Date();

  if (action === 'accept') {
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { currentState: request, code: conflictCodeFromStatus(request.status, action) };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'claimed', claimed_by_user_id = $2, claimed_by_display_name = $3,
             claimed_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq'),
             expires_at = $5
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, expectedRequestRevision, computeDefaultExpiryUtc(now, podName).toISOString()]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length > 0) {
      await notifyPodMembers({ requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' }, actor.userId);
      return { request: updated.rows[0] };
    }

    return { currentState: request, code: 'staleRevision' };
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { currentState: request, code: conflictCodeFromStatus(request.status, action) };
    }

    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { currentState: request, code: 'unauthorized' };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'reopened', claimed_by_user_id = NULL, claimed_by_display_name = NULL,
             claimed_at = NULL, reopened_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, action, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length > 0) {
      await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
        { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_reopened' },
        [request.requester_id]
      );
      return { request: updated.rows[0] };
    }

    return { currentState: request, code: 'staleRevision' };
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId || (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened')) {
      const code = request.requester_id !== actor.userId ? 'unauthorized' : conflictCodeFromStatus(request.status, action);
      return { currentState: request, code };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'requesterWithdrawn', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened') AND requester_id = $2

                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, action, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

export async function leavePod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const podId = parsePodId(req.params.podId);
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const membership = await pool.query<MembershipRow>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_memberships
          SET left_at = NOW(), status = 'revoked'
        WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL`,
      [podId, actor.userId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pods
          SET member_count = GREATEST(member_count - 1, 0)
        WHERE id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    const podResult = await client.query<PodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.member_count,
              (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
         FROM pods p
        WHERE p.id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
      return;
    }

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    res.status(200).json(podResponse(podResult.rows[0]));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'leave_pod_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {

export interface RequestStateTransition {
  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;

export function transitionRequest(
  request: Request,
  nextStatus: RequestStatus,
  context: {
    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;
    now: string;
    actorId: string;
    closeReason?: RequestCloseReason;
  }
): RequestStateTransition {
  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid request status transition: ${request.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }

  return {
    request: {
      ...request,
      status: nextStatus,
      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,
      reopenedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.reopened ? context.now : request.reopenedAt,
      closeReason:
        nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn
          ? context.closeReason ?? request.closeReason
          : nextStatus === RequestStatus.completed
            ? null
            : request.closeReason,
      claimedByUserId: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.actorId : request.claimedByUserId,
      claimedByDisplayName: request.claimedByDisplayName,
      lastRebroadcastAt: request.lastRebroadcastAt,
      note: request.note
    },
    nextStatus,
    reason: nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn ? (context.closeReason ?? RequestCloseReason.requesterWithdrawn) : undefined
  };
}

import { Pool } from 'pg';

/// Single shared pool (DEC-project_plan-001: node-postgres against managed
/// Postgres). DATABASE_URL must be set in the deploy environment; there is
/// no fallback to a local/default connection string — an unconfigured
/// environment should fail loudly at startup, not silently try localhost.
let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (!connectionString) {
      throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is not set — cannot connect to Postgres.');
    }
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.PGSSLMODE === 'disable' ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false }
    });
  }
  return pool;
}

export async function pingDatabase(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const client = await getPool().connect();
    try {
      await client.query('SELECT 1');
      return true;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

extension URLSessionRequestAPIClient: RequestAPIClient {
    func health() async throws -> HealthResponse {

        return try await send(endpoint, responseType: HealthResponse.self)
    }

    func authenticate(appleIdentityToken: String, nonce: String) async throws -> AuthSession {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .post, path: "/api/v1/auth/apple", requiresAuth: false)
        return try await send(
            endpoint,
            body: ["identityToken": appleIdentityToken, "nonce": nonce],
            responseType: AuthSession.self
        )
    }

    func createPod(name: String, timezone: String) async throws -> Pod {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .post, path: "/api/v1/pods", requiresAuth: true)
        return try await send(
            endpoint,
            body: ["name": name, "timezone": timezone],
            responseType: Pod.self
        )
    }

    func joinPod(code: String) async throws -> Pod {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .post, path: "/api/v1/pods/join", requiresAuth: true)
        return try await send(
            endpoint,
            body: ["joinCode": code],
            responseType: Pod.self
        )
    }

    func rotateJoinCode(podId: String) async throws -> Pod {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .post, path: "/api/v1/pods/\(podId)/join-code/revoke", requiresAuth: true)
        return try await send(endpoint, responseType: Pod.self)
    }

    func fetchBoardState(podId: String) async throws -> BoardState {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .get, path: "/api/v1/pods/\(podId)/state", requiresAuth: true)
        return try await send(endpoint, responseType: BoardState.self)
    }

    func postRequest(podId: String, clientActionId: String, note: String?) async throws -> Request {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .post, path: "/api/v1/pods/\(podId)/requests", requiresAuth: true)
        var body: [String: String] = ["clientActionId": clientActionId]
        if let note {
            body["note"] = note
        }
        return try await send(
            endpoint,
            body: body,
            responseType: Request.self
        )
    }

    func performAction(
        requestId: String,
        clientActionId: String,
        type: ActionType,
        expectedRequestRevision: UInt64
    ) async throws -> ActionResult {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(
            method: .post,
            path: "/api/v1/requests/\(requestId)/actions",
            requiresAuth: true
        )
        let payload = PerformActionPayload(
            clientActionId: clientActionId,
            actionType: type.rawValue,
            expectedRequestRevision: expectedRequestRevision
        )
        return try await sendAction(endpoint, action: payload)
    }

    func fetchRequest(requestId: String) async throws -> Request {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .get, path: "/api/v1/requests/\(requestId)", requiresAuth: true)
        return try await send(endpoint, responseType: Request.self)
    }

    func fetchReceipt(requestId: String) async throws -> Receipt {
        let endpoint = Endpoint(method: .get, path: "/api/v1/requests/\(requestId)/receipt", requiresAuth: true)
        return try await send(endpoint, responseType: Receipt.self)
    }

    func registerDevice(apnsToken: Data) async throws {
        let tokenValue = apnsToken.base64EncodedString()
        let endpoint = Endpoint(
            method: .post,
            path: "/api/v1/devices/apns-token",
            requiresAuth: true
        )
        try await sendWithNoContent(
            endpoint,
            body: [
                "apnsToken": tokenValue,
                "platform": "ios"
            ]
        )
    }

    func deleteAccount() async throws {
        try await sendWithNoContent(Endpoint(method: .delete, path: "/api/v1/account", requiresAuth: true))
    }
}

private struct ActionResultEnvelope: Decodable {
    let outcome: String?
    let result: String?
    let request: Request?
    let currentState: Request?
    let code: ActionConflictCode?
    let requestId: String?

    func toActionResult() throws -> ActionResult {
        let normalized = outcome ?? result ?? "conflict"
        switch APIResultStatus(rawValue: normalized) {
        case .applied:
            guard let request else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
        case .conflict:
            guard let currentState, let code else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .conflict(currentState: currentState, code: code)
        case .none:
            if normalized == "offline" {
                guard let requestId else { throw NetworkError.malformedResponse }
                return .offline(queuedActionId: requestId)
            }
            if let request {
                return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
            }
            throw NetworkError.malformedResponse

type ActionType = 'accept' | 'release' | 'withdraw' | 'complete' | 'reBroadcast';
type ConflictCode = keyof typeof CONFLICT_CODES;

function parseActionType(raw: unknown): ActionType | null {
  if (raw === 'accept' || raw === 'release' || raw === 'withdraw' || raw === 'complete' || raw === 'reBroadcast') {
    return raw;
  }
  return null;
}

  }

  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isInteger(raw) && raw >= 0) {
    return BigInt(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const normalized = raw.trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {

    }
    return BigInt(normalized);
  }

  return null;
}

  if (action === 'accept') {
    if (request.status === 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed;
    }
    if (request.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn;
    }
    if (request.status === 'completed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    if (request.status === 'reopened') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;

  if (action === 'release') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;

    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;

    }

      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
  }

  if (!podId) {

    `SELECT pod_id

    [podId, actor.userId]

  }

    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,

    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows.rows) {

    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds));
  const mappedRows = requestRows.rows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedActors));

      memberCount: pod.member_count,

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

function compareCalendarParts(left: PodCalendarParts, right: PodCalendarParts): -1 | 0 | 1 {
  const lhs = [left.year, left.month, left.day, left.hour, left.minute, left.second];
  const rhs = [right.year, right.month, right.day, right.hour, right.minute, right.second];

  for (let i = 0; i < lhs.length; i += 1) {
    if (lhs[i] < rhs[i]) return -1;
    if (lhs[i] > rhs[i]) return 1;
  }

  return 0;
}

function utcFromPodParts(parts: PodCalendarParts, timezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const candidateBase = Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day, parts.hour, parts.minute, parts.second, 0);
  let low = candidateBase - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  let high = candidateBase + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  let bestCandidate = candidateBase;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    const midParts = podLocalParts(new Date(mid), timezone);
    const cmp = compareCalendarParts(midParts, parts);

    if (cmp === 0) {
      return new Date(mid);
    }

    if (cmp < 0) {
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }

    bestCandidate = mid;
  }

  return new Date(bestCandidate);
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string, from: Date = new Date()): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const podParts = podLocalParts(from, podTimezone);
  return utcFromPodParts(podParts, podTimezone);
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);
  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const localParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const minuteOverflow = Math.floor((localParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) / 60);
  const wrappedMinute = (localParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) % 60;

  const expireParts: PodCalendarParts = {
    year: localParts.year,
    month: localParts.month,
    day: localParts.day,
    hour: localParts.hour + minuteOverflow,
    minute: wrappedMinute,
    second: localParts.second
  };

  return utcFromPodParts(expireParts, podTimezone);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

}

export async function findPodByJoinCode(code: string): Promise<Pod | null> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<PodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
       JOIN pod_join_codes pc ON pc.pod_id = p.id
      WHERE pc.code = $1 AND pc.status = 'active'
      LIMIT 1`,
    [code]
  );

  return result.rows[0] ? toPod(result.rows[0]) : null;
}

export async function createFreshJoinCodeForPod(client: PoolClient, podId: string): Promise<string> {

  await client.query(
    'INSERT INTO pod_join_codes (id, pod_id, code, status, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, \'active\', NOW())',
    [randomUUID(), podId, code]
  );

  return code;
}

    `UPDATE pod_join_codes
       SET status = 'revoked',
           rotated_at = NOW()
     WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId]
  );
}

export async function registerApnsToken(params: {
  userId: string;
  apnsToken: string;
  platform: string;
  deviceId?: string | null;
}): Promise<void> {
  const pool = getPool();
  await pool.query(
    `INSERT INTO pod_device_tokens (id, user_id, apns_token, platform, device_id, created_at, updated_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
     ON CONFLICT (user_id)
     DO UPDATE SET
       apns_[REDACTED:assignment]
       platform = EXCLUDED.platform,
       device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id,
       updated_at = NOW()`,
    [
      randomUUID(),
      params.userId,
      params.apnsToken,
      params.platform,
      params.deviceId ?? null
    ]
  );
}

async function loadPodDevices(podId: string): Promise<DeviceRow[]> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
       JOIN pod_memberships pm ON pm.user_id = pd.user_id
      WHERE pm.pod_id = $1
        AND pm.left_at IS NULL
        AND pm.status = 'active'`,
    [podId]
  );

  return result.rows;
}

async function fakePush(device: DeviceRow, payload: PodNotificationPayload): Promise<void> {
  // Placeholder APNs call path for v1. Full APNs integration is intentionally deferred.
  console.info(
    `[notify] ${payload.eventType} request=${payload.requestId} pod=${payload.podId} to=${device.user_id} (${device.platform})`
  );
}

export async function notifyPodMembers(payload: PodNotificationPayload, excludeUserId: string): Promise<void> {
  const devices = await loadPodDevices(payload.podId);
  const recipients = devices.filter((device) => device.user_id !== excludeUserId);

  await Promise.all(recipients.map((device) => fakePush(device, payload)));
}

export async function notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
  payload: PodNotificationPayload,
  watchedUserIds: string[]
): Promise<void> {
  const uniqueIds = [...new Set(watchedUserIds.filter((userId) => Boolean(userId)))];
  if (uniqueIds.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
      WHERE pd.user_id = ANY($1::uuid[])`,
    [uniqueIds]
  );

  const unique: Record<string, DeviceRow> = {};
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    unique[row.user_id] = row;
  }

  await Promise.all(Object.values(unique).map((device) => fakePush(device, payload)));
}

export enum RequestStatus {

}

export enum RequestCloseReason {
  autoExpired = 'autoExpired',
  requesterWithdrawn = 'requesterWithdrawn',
  systemHousekeeping = 'systemHousekeeping'
}

export enum ActionType {
  post = 'post',
  accept = 'accept',
  release = 'release',
  withdraw = 'withdraw',
  complete = 'complete',
  reBroadcast = 'reBroadcast'
}

export interface Request {
  id: RequestId;
  podId: string;
  requesterId: string;

  lastRebroadcastAt: string | null;

  requestRevision: string;
  displayOrder: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type RequestRevision = bigint;

export const requestTransitionMatrix: Record<RequestStatus, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.completed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

export const actionToAllowedStatuses: Record<ActionType, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {
  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);
}

export function canActorTakeAction(status: RequestStatus, action: ActionType): boolean {
  return actionToAllowedStatuses[action].has(status);
}

  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;
}

    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;

  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid request status transition: ${request.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }

  return {
    request: {

final class PushAuthorizationService: PushAuthorizationProviding {

actor FileBackedOutboxStore: OutboxStore {

    }

    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let base = directory ?? FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        let folder = base.appendingPathComponent("PulseRelay", isDirectory: true)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: folder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)

        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: storageURL.path()) {

    }

    func upsert(_ action: OutboxAction) async throws {
        var payload = try readPayload()
        if let index = payload.actions.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == action.id }) {
            payload.actions[index] = action
        } else {
            payload.actions.append(action)
        }
        try writePayload(payload)
    }

    func markResolved(_ id: String, status: OutboxStatus) async throws {
        var payload = try readPayload()
        guard let index = payload.actions.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else {
            return

        payload.actions[index].status = status
        try writePayload(payload)
    }

    func drop(_ id: String) async throws {
        var payload = try readPayload()
        payload.actions.removeAll(where: { $0.id == id })
        try writePayload(payload)
    }

        try writePayload(OutboxEnvelope(version: Constants.schemaVersion, actions: []))
    }

        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: storageURL.path()) else {

        let payload = try decoder.decode(OutboxEnvelope.self, from: data)
        if payload.version != Constants.schemaVersion {
            throw OutboxStoreError.schemaMismatch
        }
        return payload
    }

    private func writePayload(_ payload: OutboxEnvelope) throws {
        let data = try encoder.encode(payload)
        try data.write(to: storageURL, options: .atomic)
    }

async function applyAction(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  podTimezone: string,
  action: ActionType,
  actor: { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string },
  expectedRequestRevision: string

  const now = new Date();

  if (action === 'accept') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

      return { conflictCode: precheck === CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed ? precheck : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };

      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'claimed', claimed_by_user_id = $2, claimed_by_display_name = $3,
             claimed_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq'),
             expires_at = $5
       WHERE id = $1
         AND request_revision = $4::bigint
         AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, expectedRequestRevision, computeDefaultExpiryUtc(now, podTimezone).toISOString()]

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyPodMembers(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' },
      actor.userId
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'reopened', claimed_by_user_id = NULL, claimed_by_display_name = NULL,
             claimed_at = NULL, reopened_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, action, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_reopened' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'requesterWithdrawn', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened') AND requester_id = $2
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,

    );

    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(

      [request.requester_id]

    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };

      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_completed' },
      [request.requester_id, request.claimed_by_user_id]
    );

    return { request: completed };
  }

  const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
  if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
    return { conflictCode: precheck };
  }

  if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
  }
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
  }

  const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
       SET last_rebroadcast_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
     WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint
       AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
     RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
               claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
               last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
  );

  if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
  }

  const updatedRequest = updated.rows[0];
  await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
    { requestId: updatedRequest.id, podId: updatedRequest.pod_id, eventType: 'request_rebroadcast' },
    [updatedRequest.requester_id, updatedRequest.claimed_by_user_id ?? '']
  );

  return { request: updatedRequest };
}

  const actionType = parseActionType(req.body?.actionType);
  if (!actionType) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_action_type' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = String(req.body?.clientActionId ?? '').trim();
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevision = parseExpectedRevision(req.body?.expectedRequestRevision);
  if (expectedRevision === null) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_or_invalid_expected_revision' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevisionString = expectedRevision.toString();
  const pool = getPool();

  const existingLog = await loadActionLog(pool, actor.userId, clientActionId);
  if (existingLog) {
    if (existingLog.outcome === 'applied' && existingLog.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: toRequestResponse(existingLog.result_snapshot)

      return;

    if (snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({

        code: existingLog.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,

    res.status(409).json({
      outcome: 'conflict',
      result: 'conflict',

      requestId

    return;
  }

  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,

      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: expectedRevisionString,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      snapshot: null

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { PoolClient } from 'pg';
import { getPool } from '../db';
import { Pod, isCreator } from '../models/pod';

interface PodRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  creator_id: string;
  created_by: string;
  home_timezone: string;
  member_count: number;
  join_code: string | null;
}

interface JoinCodeRow {
  code: string;
}

const CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 12;

function createCandidateCode(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(8);
  const alphabet = '[REDACTED:high_entropy]';
  let value = '';

  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
    value += alphabet[bytes[index] % alphabet.length];
  }

  return value;
}

async function nextAvailableCode(): Promise<string> {
  const pool = getPool();
  let attempt = 0;

  while (attempt < CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    const candidate = createCandidateCode();
    const existing = await pool.query<JoinCodeRow>('SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE code = $1', [candidate]);

    if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
      return candidate;
    }

    attempt += 1;
  }

  throw new Error('join_code_generation_exhausted');
}

function toPod(row: PodRow): Pod {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    creatorId: row.creator_id,
    homeTimezone: row.home_timezone,
    joinCode: row.join_code ?? '',
    joinCodeStatus: 'active',
    memberCount: row.member_count,
    createdBy: row.created_by,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

function compareCalendarParts(left: PodCalendarParts, right: PodCalendarParts): -1 | 0 | 1 {
  const lhs = [left.year, left.month, left.day, left.hour, left.minute, left.second];
  const rhs = [right.year, right.month, right.day, right.hour, right.minute, right.second];

  for (let i = 0; i < lhs.length; i += 1) {
    if (lhs[i] < rhs[i]) return -1;
    if (lhs[i] > rhs[i]) return 1;
  }

  return 0;
}

function utcFromPodParts(parts: PodCalendarParts, timezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const candidateBase = Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day, parts.hour, parts.minute, parts.second, 0);
  let low = candidateBase - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  let high = candidateBase + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  let bestCandidate = candidateBase;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    const midParts = podLocalParts(new Date(mid), timezone);
    const cmp = compareCalendarParts(midParts, parts);

    if (cmp === 0) {
      return new Date(mid);
    }

    if (cmp < 0) {
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }

    bestCandidate = mid;
  }

  return new Date(bestCandidate);
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string, from: Date = new Date()): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const podParts = podLocalParts(from, podTimezone);
  return utcFromPodParts(podParts, podTimezone);
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);
  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const localParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const minuteOverflow = Math.floor((localParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) / 60);
  const wrappedMinute = (localParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) % 60;

  const expireParts: PodCalendarParts = {
    year: localParts.year,
    month: localParts.month,
    day: localParts.day,
    hour: localParts.hour + minuteOverflow,
    minute: wrappedMinute,
    second: localParts.second
  };

  return utcFromPodParts(expireParts, podTimezone);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

  return randomUUID();

export async function getRequest(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order,
            note, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'request_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const member = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (member.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const scope = await deletedActorsFor([request.requester_id]);
  if (request.claimed_by_user_id) {
    scope.add(request.claimed_by_user_id);
  }

  res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(request, scope));
}

export async function fetchPodState(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status IN ('open','claimed','reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<RequestStateRow>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const requests = await buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool, requestRows.rows);

  const serverNow = podNowUtc(podResult.rows[0].home_timezone).toISOString();

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]),
    requests,
    boardRevision: Number(boardNowRequestRevision(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision)),
    serverNowUtc: serverNow
  });
}

function boardNowRequestRevision(raw: string | undefined): string {
  return raw ?? '0';
}

type ActionType = 'accept' | 'release' | 'withdraw' | 'complete' | 'reBroadcast';
type ConflictCode = keyof typeof CONFLICT_CODES;

function parseActionType(raw: unknown): ActionType | null {
  if (raw === 'accept' || raw === 'release' || raw === 'withdraw' || raw === 'complete' || raw === 'reBroadcast') {

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podTimezone: string
): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return null;
  }

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(request.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {
    return null;
  }

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
        SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'autoExpired', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')

async function applyAction(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  podTimezone: string,
  action: ActionType,
  actor: { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string },
  expectedRequestRevision: string
): Promise<{ request?: DbRequestRow; conflictCode?: ConflictCode }> {
  const now = new Date();

  if (action === 'accept') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: precheck === CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed ? precheck : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'claimed', claimed_by_user_id = $2, claimed_by_display_name = $3,
             claimed_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq'),
             expires_at = $5

      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' },
      actor.userId
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

function compareCalendarParts(left: PodCalendarParts, right: PodCalendarParts): -1 | 0 | 1 {
  const lhs = [left.year, left.month, left.day, left.hour, left.minute, left.second];
  const rhs = [right.year, right.month, right.day, right.hour, right.minute, right.second];

  for (let i = 0; i < lhs.length; i += 1) {
    if (lhs[i] < rhs[i]) return -1;
    if (lhs[i] > rhs[i]) return 1;
  }

  return 0;
}

function utcFromPodParts(parts: PodCalendarParts, timezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const candidateBase = Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day, parts.hour, parts.minute, parts.second, 0);
  let low = candidateBase - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  let high = candidateBase + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  let bestCandidate = candidateBase;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    const midParts = podLocalParts(new Date(mid), timezone);
    const cmp = compareCalendarParts(midParts, parts);

    if (cmp === 0) {
      return new Date(mid);
    }

    if (cmp < 0) {
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }

    bestCandidate = mid;
  }

  return new Date(bestCandidate);
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string, from: Date = new Date()): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const podParts = podLocalParts(from, podTimezone);
  return utcFromPodParts(podParts, podTimezone);
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);
  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const localParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const minuteOverflow = Math.floor((localParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) / 60);
  const wrappedMinute = (localParts.minute + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) % 60;

  const expireParts: PodCalendarParts = {
    year: localParts.year,
    month: localParts.month,
    day: localParts.day,
    hour: localParts.hour + minuteOverflow,
    minute: wrappedMinute,
    second: localParts.second
  };

  return utcFromPodParts(expireParts, podTimezone);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

export function newAuditToken(): string {
  return randomUUID();
}

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_reopened' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'requesterWithdrawn', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened') AND requester_id = $2
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_withdrawn' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'completed', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    const completed = updated.rows[0];
    const acceptedAt = request.claimed_at ? new Date(request.claimed_at) : new Date();
    const completedAt = now;

    await ensureReceiptForCompletion(client, completed, podName, acceptedAt, completedAt);
    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_completed' },
      [request.requester_id, request.claimed_by_user_id]
    );

    return { request: completed };
  }

  const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
  if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
    return { conflictCode: precheck };
  }

  if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
  }
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
  }

  const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
       SET last_rebroadcast_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
     WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $4::bigint
       AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
     RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
               claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
               last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
  );

  if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
  }

  const updatedRequest = updated.rows[0];
  await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
    { requestId: updatedRequest.id, podId: updatedRequest.pod_id, eventType: 'request_rebroadcast' },
    [updatedRequest.requester_id, updatedRequest.claimed_by_user_id ?? '']
  );

  return { request: updatedRequest };
}

export async function acceptRequest(req: ActorRequest & { body: ActionBody }, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const actionType = parseActionType(req.body?.actionType);
  if (!actionType) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_action_type' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = String(req.body?.clientActionId ?? '').trim();
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevision = parseExpectedRevision(req.body?.expectedRequestRevision);
  if (expectedRevision === null) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_or_invalid_expected_revision' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevisionString = expectedRevision.toString();
  const pool = getPool();

  const existingLog = await loadActionLog(pool, actor.userId, clientActionId);
  if (existingLog) {
    if (existingLog.outcome === 'applied' && existingLog.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: toRequestResponse(existingLog.result_snapshot)
      });
      return;
    }

    const snapshot = existingLog.result_snapshot;
    if (snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        outcome: 'conflict',
        result: 'conflict',
        currentState: toRequestResponse(snapshot),
        code: existingLog.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
        requestId
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({
      outcome: 'conflict',
      result: 'conflict',
      code: existingLog.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      requestId
    });
    return;
  }

  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: expectedRevisionString,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      snapshot: null
    });

    res.status(409).json({ outcome: 'conflict', result: 'conflict', code: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown, requestId });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized,
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized));
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    'SELECT id, name, home_timezone FROM pods WHERE id = $1',
    [request.pod_id]
  );
  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  if (!pod) {
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.unknown));
    return;
  }

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const autoExpired = await maybeAutoExpireRequest(client, request, pod.home_timezone);
    if (autoExpired) {
      await writeActionLog(pool, {
        userId: actor.userId,
        requestId: autoExpired.id,
        actionId: clientActionId,
        actionType,
        requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
        requestRevisionAfter: autoExpired.request_revision,
        outcome: 'conflict',
        conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.expired,
        snapshot: autoExpired
      });
      await client.query('COMMIT');
      res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(autoExpired, CONFLICT_CODES.expired));
      return;
    }

    const attempt = await applyAction(client, request, pod.name, pod.home_timezone, actionType, actor, expectedRevisionString);

    if (attempt.request) {
      await writeActionLog(pool, {
        userId: actor.userId,
        requestId: request.id,
        actionId: clientActionId,
        actionType,
        requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
        requestRevisionAfter: attempt.request.request_revision,
        outcome: 'applied',
        conflictCode: null,
        snapshot: attempt.request
      });

      await client.query('COMMIT');
      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: toRequestResponse(attempt.request)
      });
      return;
    }

    const conflictCode = attempt.conflictCode ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown;
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId: request.id,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode,
      snapshot: request
    });

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(request, conflictCode));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'accept_request_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

protocol CacheStore: Sendable {
    func loadPodState(podId: String) async throws -> Pod?
    func savePodState(_ pod: Pod, revision: UInt64) async throws
    func loadBoard(podId: String) async throws -> [CachedRequest]
    func replaceBoard(podId: String, requests: [CachedRequest]) async throws
    func deletePod(_ podId: String) async throws
    func clearIfSchemaIncompatible(_ error: Error) async throws
}

actor FileBackedCacheStore: CacheStore {
    private enum Constants {
        static let podFilenameSuffix = "pod.json"
        static let boardFilenameSuffix = "board.json"
        static let revisionFilenameSuffix = "revision.txt"
        static let schemaVersion = 1
    }

    private let rootURL: URL
    private let encoder = JSONEncoder()
    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()

    init(directory: URL? = nil) throws {
        let base = directory ?? FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        rootURL = base.appendingPathComponent("PulseRelay", isDirectory: true)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: rootURL, withIntermediateDirectories: true)

        let marker = rootURL.appendingPathComponent("schema-version.txt")
        let schemaPayload = try Self.makeSchemaPayload()
        if let markerData = try? Data(contentsOf: marker),
           let markerString = String(data: markerData, encoding: .utf8),
           Int(markerString.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)) != Constants.schemaVersion {
            try FileBackedCacheStore.clearAll(at: rootURL)
            try schemaPayload.write(to: marker)
        } else if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: marker.path()) {
            try schemaPayload.write(to: marker)
        }
    }

    func loadPodState(podId: String) async throws -> Pod? {
        let url = podFileURL(podId: podId)
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path()) else { return nil }
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        return try decoder.decode(CachedPodPayload.self, from: data).pod
    }

    func savePodState(_ pod: Pod, revision: UInt64) async throws {
        let payload = CachedPodPayload(version: Constants.schemaVersion, revision: revision, pod: pod)
        let data = try encoder.encode(payload)
        try data.write(to: podFileURL(podId: pod.id), options: .atomic)
    }

    func loadBoard(podId: String) async throws -> [CachedRequest] {
        let url = boardFileURL(podId: podId)
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path()) else { return [] }
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        let payload = try decoder.decode(CachedBoardPayload.self, from: data)
        guard payload.version == Constants.schemaVersion else {
            throw CacheStoreError.schemaMismatch
        }
        return payload.requests
    }

    func replaceBoard(podId: String, requests: [CachedRequest]) async throws {
        let payload = CachedBoardPayload(version: Constants.schemaVersion, requests: requests)
        let data = try encoder.encode(payload)
        try data.write(to: boardFileURL(podId: podId), options: .atomic)
    }

    func deletePod(_ podId: String) async throws {
        try deleteIfExists(podFileURL(podId: podId))
        try deleteIfExists(boardFileURL(podId: podId))
        try deleteIfExists(revisionFileURL(podId: podId))
    }

    }

enum PushAuthorizationError: Error, LocalizedError {
    case denied
    case systemRestricted

final class PushAuthorizationService: PushAuthorizationProviding {
    func requestIfNeeded() async throws -> Bool {
        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
        let settings = await center.notificationSettings()
        if settings.authorizationStatus == .denied {
            throw PushAuthorizationError.denied
        }
        if settings.authorizationStatus == .notDetermined {

            return granted
        }
        if settings.authorizationStatus != .authorized && settings.authorizationStatus != .provisional {
            throw PushAuthorizationError.systemRestricted
        }
        return true
    }

import Foundation

enum CoordinatorActionErrorCategory: Equatable {
    case retryable
    case terminal
    case unknown
}

enum CoordinatorFailurePolicy {
    static func category(for error: Error) -> CoordinatorActionErrorCategory {
        switch error {
        case NetworkError.requestTimeout, NetworkError.noResponse, NetworkError.transport:
            return .retryable
        case NetworkError.serverError(let statusCode) where statusCode >= 500:
            return .retryable
        case NetworkError.conflict,
             NetworkError.forbidden,
             NetworkError.unauthorized,
             NetworkError.decoding,
             NetworkError.malformedResponse,
             NetworkError.invalidURL:
            return .terminal
        default:
            return .unknown
        }
    }
}

export type RequestId = string;

export enum RequestStatus {
  open = 'open',
  claimed = 'claimed',
  reopened = 'reopened',
  withdrawn = 'withdrawn',
  completed = 'completed'
}

export enum RequestCloseReason {
  autoExpired = 'autoExpired',
  requesterWithdrawn = 'requesterWithdrawn',
  systemHousekeeping = 'systemHousekeeping'
}

export enum ActionType {
  post = 'post',
  accept = 'accept',
  release = 'release',
  withdraw = 'withdraw',
  complete = 'complete',

}

export interface Request {

  reopenedAt: string | null;
  lastRebroadcastAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  requestRevision: string;
  displayOrder: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type RequestRevision = bigint;

export const requestTransitionMatrix: Record<RequestStatus, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.completed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

export const actionToAllowedStatuses: Record<ActionType, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {
  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);
}

export function canActorTakeAction(status: RequestStatus, action: ActionType): boolean {
  return actionToAllowedStatuses[action].has(status);
}

export interface RequestStateTransition {
  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;
}

export function transitionRequest(
  request: Request,
  nextStatus: RequestStatus,
  context: {
    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;
    now: string;
    actorId: string;
    closeReason?: RequestCloseReason;
  }
): RequestStateTransition {
  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid request status transition: ${request.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }

  return {
    request: {
      ...request,
      status: nextStatus,
      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,
      reopenedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.reopened ? context.now : request.reopenedAt,
      closeReason:

    reason: nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn ? (context.closeReason ?? RequestCloseReason.requesterWithdrawn) : undefined

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import { computeDefaultExpiryUtc, podLocalParts, samePodCalendarDay } from './time_util';

test('computeDefaultExpiryUtc advances by configured minutes in pod timezone', () => {
  const podTimezone = 'America/New_York';
  const issuedAt = new Date('2025-03-09T04:00:00.000Z');
  const expiry = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt, podTimezone);
  const expiredAtParts = podLocalParts(expiry, podTimezone);
  const issuedParts = podLocalParts(issuedAt, podTimezone);

  assert.equal(expiredAtParts.hour, (issuedParts.hour + 5) % 60 === 0 ? issuedParts.hour + 0 : issuedAt.getUTCHours());
  assert.equal(expiredAtParts.minute, issuedParts.minute + 5 >= 60 ? issuedParts.minute + 5 - 60 : issuedParts.minute + 5);
});

test('samePodCalendarDay is false across pod-local midnight even near DST boundary', () => {
  const tz = 'America/New_York';
  const first = new Date('2025-03-09T04:50:00.000Z'); // around spring-forward
  const next = new Date('2025-03-09T05:10:00.000Z');

  assert.equal(samePodCalendarDay(first, next, tz), false);
});
