export async function fetchPodState(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status IN ('open','claimed','reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<RequestStateRow>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const requests = await buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool, requestRows.rows);

  const serverNow = podNowUtc(podResult.rows[0].home_timezone).toISOString();

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]),
    requests,
    boardRevision: Number(boardNowRequestRevision(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision)),
    serverNowUtc: serverNow
  });
}

function boardNowRequestRevision(raw: string | undefined): string {
  return raw ?? '0';
}

export async function postRequestInPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = parseClientActionId(req.body?.clientActionId);
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_client_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const note = req.body?.note ? String(req.body.note).trim() : null;
  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podRow = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    'SELECT id, home_timezone, name, creator_id, created_by, member_count FROM pods WHERE id = $1',
    [podId]
  );
  if (podRow.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const duplicate = await pool.query<ActionLogRow>(
    `SELECT id, request_id, request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot
       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,
    [actor.userId, clientActionId]
  );

  if (duplicate.rows.length > 0) {
    const existing = duplicate.rows[0];
    if (existing.outcome === 'applied' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      const request = toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id]));
      res.status(200).json(request);
      return;
    }

    if (existing.outcome === 'conflict' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        currentState: toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id])),
        code: existing.conflict_code ?? 'staleRevision',
        outcome: 'conflict'
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action', requestId: existing.request_id });
    return;
  }

  const podTimezone = podRow.rows[0].home_timezone;
  const expiresAtUtc = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(new Date(), podTimezone);

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const requestId = randomUUID();
    const requestResult = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `INSERT INTO requests (
         id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status,
         claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at, last_rebroadcast_at,
         expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'open', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, $6, NOW(), DEFAULT, NOW())
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [requestId, podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, note, expiresAtUtc.toISOString()]
    );

    if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('request_not_created');
    }

    const created = requestResult.rows[0];
    const requestRevisionBefore = Number(created.request_revision) > 0 ? Number(created.request_revision) - 1 : 0;
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO request_action_log (
         id, user_id, request_id, action_id, action_type,
         request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot, created_at
       ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'post', $5, $6, 'applied', NULL, $7::jsonb, NOW())`,
      [
        randomUUID(),
        actor.userId,
        requestId,
        clientActionId,
        String(requestRevisionBefore),
        created.request_revision,
        JSON.stringify(created)
      ]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    await notifyPodMembers({ requestId: created.id, podId, eventType: 'request_posted' }, actor.userId);

    res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(created, await resolveDeletedUsers([created.requester_id])));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    if ((error as { code?: string }).code === '23505') {
      const repeated = await pool.query<{ request_id: string | null }>(
        'SELECT request_id FROM request_action_log WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1',
        [actor.userId, clientActionId]
      );
      if (repeated.rows.length > 0 && repeated.rows[0].request_id) {
        const existing = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
          `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                  claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                  last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
             FROM requests WHERE id = $1`,
          [repeated.rows[0].request_id]
        );
        if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
          const request = toRequestResponse(existing.rows[0], await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.rows[0].requester_id]));
          res.status(200).json(request);
          return;
        }
      }

      res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'request_post_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

export async function acceptRequest(req: ActorRequest & { body: ActionBody }, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });

  userId: string;
  apnsToken: string;
  platform: string;
  deviceId?: string | null;
}): Promise<void> {
  const pool = getPool();
  await pool.query(
    `INSERT INTO pod_device_tokens (id, user_id, apns_token, platform, device_id, created_at, updated_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
     ON CONFLICT (user_id)

       platform = EXCLUDED.platform,
       device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id,

    [

      params.userId,
      params.apnsToken,
      params.platform,
      params.deviceId ?? null
    ]
  );
}

async function loadPodDevices(podId: string): Promise<DeviceRow[]> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
       JOIN pod_memberships pm ON pm.user_id = pd.user_id
      WHERE pm.pod_id = $1
        AND pm.left_at IS NULL
        AND pm.status = 'active'`,
    [podId]
  );

  return result.rows;
}

}

export async function notifyPodMembers(payload: PodNotificationPayload, excludeUserId: string): Promise<void> {
  const devices = await loadPodDevices(payload.podId);
  const recipients = devices.filter((device) => device.user_id !== excludeUserId);

  await Promise.all(recipients.map((device) => fakePush(device, payload)));
}

export async function notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
  payload: PodNotificationPayload,
  watchedUserIds: string[]
): Promise<void> {
  const uniqueIds = [...new Set(watchedUserIds.filter((userId) => Boolean(userId)))];
  if (uniqueIds.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
      WHERE pd.user_id = ANY($1::uuid[])`,
    [uniqueIds]
  );

  const unique: Record<string, DeviceRow> = {};
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    unique[row.user_id] = row;
  }

  await Promise.all(Object.values(unique).map((device) => fakePush(device, payload)));
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import { computeDefaultExpiryUtc, podLocalParts, samePodCalendarDay } from './time_util';

test('computeDefaultExpiryUtc is a fixed UTC duration and independent of the server host timezone', () => {
  const podTimezone = 'America/New_York';
  const issuedAt = new Date('2025-03-09T04:00:00.000Z');
  const expiry = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt, podTimezone);

  const expected = new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + 5 * 60 * 1000);
  assert.equal(expiry.toISOString(), expected.toISOString());
});

test('samePodCalendarDay uses pod timezone for day boundaries, not host timezone', () => {
  const source = new Date('2025-01-01T00:10:00.000Z');
  const nearNoonLocal = new Date('2025-01-01T23:10:00.000Z');

  // In America/New_York both instants are the same local day.
  assert.equal(samePodCalendarDay(source, nearNoonLocal, 'America/New_York'), true);

  // In Asia/Kolkata the same pair crosses calendar day.
  assert.equal(samePodCalendarDay(source, nearNoonLocal, 'Asia/Kolkata'), false);
});

test('podLocalParts exposes pod-local components for arbitrary valid times', () => {
  const podTimezone = 'America/Los_Angeles';
  const instant = new Date('2025-11-02T09:17:30.000Z');
  const parts = podLocalParts(instant, podTimezone);

  assert.equal(typeof parts.year, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.month, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.day, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.hour, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.minute, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.second, 'number');
});

final class URLSessionRequestAPIClient {
    private let baseURL: URL
    private let session: URLSession
    private let tokenProvider: @Sendable () -> String?
    private let jsonDecoder: JSONDecoder
    private let jsonEncoder: JSONEncoder
    private let timeout: TimeInterval

    init(
        baseURL: URL,
        session: URLSession = .shared,
        tokenProvider: @escaping @Sendable () -> String? = { nil },
        timeout: TimeInterval = 12
    ) {
        self.baseURL = baseURL
        self.session = session
        self.tokenProvider = tokenProvider
        self.timeout = timeout

        let decoder = JSONDecoder()
        decoder.dateDecodingStrategy = .iso8601
        decoder.keyDecodingStrategy = .convertFromSnakeCase
        self.jsonDecoder = decoder

        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        encoder.dateEncodingStrategy = .iso8601
        encoder.keyEncodingStrategy = .convertToSnakeCase
        self.jsonEncoder = encoder
    }

    private var authHeaderValue: String? {
        guard let [REDACTED:assignment] !token.isEmpty else {
            return nil
        }
        return "Bearer \(token)"
    }

    private func makeURLRequest(path: String, method: HTTPMethod) throws -> URLRequest {
        guard let url = URL(string: path, relativeTo: baseURL) else {
            throw NetworkError.invalidURL
        }
        guard var components = URLComponents(url: url, resolvingAgainstBaseURL: true) else {
            throw NetworkError.invalidURL
        }
        components.scheme = baseURL.scheme
        components.host = baseURL.host
        components.port = baseURL.port

        guard let resolvedURL = components.url else {
            throw NetworkError.invalidURL
        }
        var request = URLRequest(url: resolvedURL)
        request.httpMethod = method.rawValue
        request.timeoutInterval = timeout
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Accept")
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
        if let header = authHeaderValue {
            request.setValue(header, forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
        }
        return request
    }

    private func decodeNoContent(from data: Data) throws -> Bool {
        guard data.isEmpty else {
            return true
        }
        return true
    }

    private func send<T: Decodable>(
        _ endpoint: Endpoint,
        body: Encodable? = nil,
        responseType: T.Type
    ) async throws -> T {
        var request = try makeURLRequest(path: endpoint.path, method: endpoint.method)
        if let body {
            do {
                request.httpBody = try jsonEncoder.encode(AnyEncodable(body))
            } catch {
                throw NetworkError.transport(underlying: error.localizedDescription)
            }
        }

        do {
            let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
            guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
                throw NetworkError.noResponse
            }

            guard (200...299).contains(http.statusCode) else {
                throw mapHTTPError(statusCode: http.statusCode, responseData: data)
            }

            if T.self == EmptyResponse.self {
                _ = try decodeNoContent(from: data)
                return EmptyResponse() as! T
            }

            do {
                return try jsonDecoder.decode(T.self, from: data)
            } catch {
                throw NetworkError.decoding(message: error.localizedDescription)
            }
        } catch let error as NetworkError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            if (error as? URLError)?.code == .timedOut {
                throw NetworkError.requestTimeout
            }
            throw NetworkError.transport(underlying: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    private func sendAction(
        _ endpoint: Endpoint,
        action: PerformActionPayload
    ) async throws -> ActionResult {
        var request = try makeURLRequest(path: endpoint.path, method: endpoint.method)
        request.httpBody = try jsonEncoder.encode(AnyEncodable(action))
        do {
            let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
            guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
                throw NetworkError.noResponse
            }

            if (200...299).contains(http.statusCode) {
                let envelope = try jsonDecoder.decode(ActionResultEnvelope.self, from: data)
                return try envelope.toActionResult()
            }

            if http.statusCode == 409 {
                let envelope = try jsonDecoder.decode(ActionResultEnvelope.self, from: data)
                if let currentState = envelope.currentState, let code = envelope.code {
                    return .conflict(currentState: currentState, code: code)
                }
                throw NetworkError.conflict(message: "409 conflict")
            }

            throw mapHTTPError(statusCode: http.statusCode, responseData: data)
        } catch let error as NetworkError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            if (error as? URLError)?.code == .timedOut {
                throw NetworkError.requestTimeout
            }
            throw NetworkError.transport(underlying: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    private func sendWithNoContent(_ endpoint: Endpoint, body: Encodable? = nil) async throws {
        var request = try makeURLRequest(path: endpoint.path, method: endpoint.method)
        if let body {
            request.httpBody = try jsonEncoder.encode(AnyEncodable(body))
        }

        do {
            let (_, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
            guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
                throw NetworkError.noResponse
            }
            if !(200...299).contains(http.statusCode) {
                throw NetworkError.serverError(statusCode: http.statusCode)
            }
        } catch let error as NetworkError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            if (error as? URLError)?.code == .timedOut {
                throw NetworkError.requestTimeout
            }
            throw NetworkError.transport(underlying: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    private func mapHTTPError(statusCode: Int, responseData: Data) -> NetworkError {
        let parsed = try? jsonDecoder.decode(APIErrorEnvelope.self, from: responseData)
        let reason = parsed?.reason ?? parsed?.message
        switch statusCode {
        case 401:
            return .unauthorized
        case 403:
            return .forbidden(message: reason)
        case 409:
            return .conflict(message: reason ?? "Conflict")
        case 500...599:
            return .serverError(statusCode: statusCode)
        default:
            return .serverError(statusCode: statusCode)
        }
    }
}

private struct ActionResultEnvelope: Decodable {
    let outcome: String?
    let result: String?
    let request: Request?
    let currentState: Request?
    let code: ActionConflictCode?
    let requestId: String?

    func toActionResult() throws -> ActionResult {
        let normalized = outcome ?? result ?? "conflict"
        switch APIResultStatus(rawValue: normalized) {
        case .applied:
            guard let request else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
        case .conflict:
            guard let currentState, let code else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
            }
            return .conflict(currentState: currentState, code: code)
        case .none:
            if normalized == "offline" {
                guard let requestId else { throw NetworkError.malformedResponse }
                return .offline(queuedActionId: requestId)
            }
            if let request {
                return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
            }
            throw NetworkError.malformedResponse

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const podId = parsePodId(req.params.podId);
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const membership = await pool.query<MembershipRow>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_memberships
          SET left_at = NOW(), status = 'revoked'
        WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL`,
      [podId, actor.userId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pods
          SET member_count = GREATEST(member_count - 1, 0)
        WHERE id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    const podResult = await client.query<PodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.member_count,
              (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
         FROM pods p
        WHERE p.id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
      return;
    }

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    res.status(200).json(podResponse(podResult.rows[0]));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'leave_pod_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

type ActionType = 'accept' | 'release' | 'withdraw' | 'complete' | 'reBroadcast';
type ConflictCode = keyof typeof CONFLICT_CODES;

function parseActionType(raw: unknown): ActionType | null {
  if (raw === 'accept' || raw === 'release' || raw === 'withdraw' || raw === 'complete' || raw === 'reBroadcast') {
    return raw;

  return null;

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): bigint | null {

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'reBroadcast') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
  }

  return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
}

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podTimezone: string
): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(request.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
        SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'autoExpired', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')

      RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,

    [request.id]

async function applyAction(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  podTimezone: string,
  action: ActionType,
  actor: { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string },
  expectedRequestRevision: string
): Promise<{ request?: DbRequestRow; conflictCode?: ConflictCode }> {
  const now = new Date();

  if (action === 'accept') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: precheck === CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed ? precheck : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

  const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
       SET status = 'claimed', claimed_by_user_id = $2, claimed_by_display_name = $3,
            claimed_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq'),
             expires_at = $5
       WHERE id = $1
         AND request_revision = $4::bigint
         AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, expectedRequestRevision, computeDefaultExpiryUtc(now, podTimezone).toISOString()]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyPodMembers(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' },
      actor.userId
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'reopened', claimed_by_user_id = NULL, claimed_by_display_name = NULL,
             claimed_at = NULL, reopened_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_reopened' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'requesterWithdrawn', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened') AND requester_id = $2
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_withdrawn' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'completed', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'

                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

export async function listOpenRequests(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const podId = req.params.podId;
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1
        AND status IN ('open', 'claimed', 'reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<{ max_revision: string }>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const safeRevision = Number(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision ?? 0);
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows.rows) {
    actorIds.add(row.requester_id);
    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }
  }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds));
  const mappedRows = requestRows.rows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedActors));

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: {
      id: pod.id,
      name: pod.name,
      homeTimezone: pod.home_timezone,
      memberCount: pod.member_count,
      joinCode: pod.join_code ?? '',
      joinCodeStatus: 'active',
      createdBy: pod.created_by
    } as PodResponse,
    requests: mappedRows,
    boardRevision: safeRevision,
    serverNowUtc: new Date().toISOString()
  } as const);
}

  requestedAt: string;
  acceptedAt: string;
  completedAt: string;
  isShareableProjection: boolean;
}

function toRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow, deletedActors: Set<string>): RequestResponse {
  const requesterDisplayName = deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name;
  const claimedByDisplayName = row.claimed_by_user_id && deletedActors.has(row.claimed_by_user_id)
    ? 'Former member'
    : row.claimed_by_display_name;

  return {
    id: row.id,
    podId: row.pod_id,
    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName,
    note: row.note,
    status: row.status,
    closeReason: row.close_reason,

    claimedByDisplayName,
    claimedAt: row.claimed_at,
    reopenedAt: row.reopened_at,

    expiresAt: row.expires_at,
    requestRevision: Number(row.request_revision),
    displayOrder: Number(row.display_order),
    createdAt: row.created_at
  };
}

function toReceiptResponse(row: DbReceiptRow): ReceiptResponse {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    requestId: row.request_id,
    podName: row.pod_name,
    requesterName: row.requester_name,
    accepterName: row.accepter_name,
    requestedAt: row.requested_at,
    acceptedAt: row.accepted_at,
    completedAt: row.completed_at,
    isShareableProjection: row.is_shareable_projection
  };
}

async function deletedActorsFor(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {
    return new Set<string>();
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeletedActorRow>('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])', [ids]);
  const deleted = new Set<string>();

  for (const row of result.rows) {
    if (row.deleted_at !== null) {
      deleted.add(row.id);
    }
  }

  return deleted;
}

function validateActor(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string } | null {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return null;
  }

  return actor;
}

export async function getRequest(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order,
            note, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'request_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const member = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (member.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const scope = await deletedActorsFor([request.requester_id]);
  if (request.claimed_by_user_id) {
    scope.add(request.claimed_by_user_id);
  }

  res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(request, scope));
}

export async function getReceipt(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    'SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason, claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at, last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, note, created_at FROM requests WHERE id = $1',
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'request_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const receiptResult = await pool.query<DbReceiptRow>(
    'SELECT id, request_id, pod_name, requester_name, accepter_name, requested_at, accepted_at, completed_at, is_shareable_projection FROM receipts WHERE request_id = $1',
    [requestId]
  );

  if (receiptResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'receipt_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  res.status(200).json(toReceiptResponse(receiptResult.rows[0]));
}

  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const name = String(req.body?.name ?? '').trim();
  const timezone = String(req.body?.timezone ?? '').trim();

  if (!name || !timezone) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_name_or_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    assertTimezone(timezone);
  } catch {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const podId = randomUUID();

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pods (id, name, creator_id, home_timezone, member_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0, $3, NOW(), NOW())`,
      [podId, name, actor.userId, timezone]
    );

    await createFreshJoinCodeForPod(client, podId);

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_memberships (id, pod_id, user_id, display_alias, is_creator, joined_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, TRUE, NOW(), 'active')`,
      [randomUUID(), podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias]
    );

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET member_count = member_count + 1 WHERE id = $1', [podId]);

    const podResult = await client.query<DbPodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
              (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
         FROM pods p WHERE p.id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
      res.status(500).json({ reason: 'pod_readback_failed' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(200).json(toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'create_pod_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

  const issuedAt = new Date('2025-03-09T04:00:00.000Z');
  const expiry = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt, podTimezone);

});

  const source = new Date('2025-01-01T00:10:00.000Z');
  const nearNoonLocal = new Date('2025-01-01T23:10:00.000Z');

  // In America/New_York both instants are the same local day.
  assert.equal(samePodCalendarDay(source, nearNoonLocal, 'America/New_York'), true);

});

export async function fetchPodState(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status IN ('open','claimed','reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<RequestStateRow>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const requests = await buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool, requestRows.rows);

  const serverNow = podNowUtc(podResult.rows[0].home_timezone).toISOString();

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]),
    requests,
    boardRevision: Number(boardNowRequestRevision(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision)),
    serverNowUtc: serverNow
  });
}

    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

    `SELECT id, request_id, request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot
       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,
    [actor.userId, clientActionId]
  );

  if (duplicate.rows.length > 0) {
    const existing = duplicate.rows[0];
    if (existing.outcome === 'applied' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      const request = toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id]));
      res.status(200).json(request);
      return;
    }

    if (existing.outcome === 'conflict' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        currentState: toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id])),
        code: existing.conflict_code ?? 'staleRevision',
        outcome: 'conflict'

      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action', requestId: existing.request_id });
    return;
  }

  const expiresAtUtc = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(new Date(), podTimezone);

    const requestId = randomUUID();
    const requestResult = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `INSERT INTO requests (

         request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot, created_at

      [

        'SELECT request_id FROM request_action_log WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1',
        [actor.userId, clientActionId]
      );
      if (repeated.rows.length > 0 && repeated.rows[0].request_id) {
        const existing = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
          `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                  claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                  last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
             FROM requests WHERE id = $1`,
          [repeated.rows[0].request_id]
        );
        if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
          const request = toRequestResponse(existing.rows[0], await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.rows[0].requester_id]));
          res.status(200).json(request);
          return;
        }
      }

      res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'request_post_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

export type RequestId = string;

export enum RequestStatus {
  open = 'open',
  claimed = 'claimed',
  reopened = 'reopened',
  withdrawn = 'withdrawn',
  completed = 'completed'
}

export enum RequestCloseReason {
  autoExpired = 'autoExpired',
  requesterWithdrawn = 'requesterWithdrawn',
  systemHousekeeping = 'systemHousekeeping'
}

export enum ActionType {
  post = 'post',
  accept = 'accept',
  release = 'release',
  withdraw = 'withdraw',
  complete = 'complete',
  reBroadcast = 'reBroadcast'
}

export interface Request {
  id: RequestId;
  podId: string;
  requesterId: string;
  requesterDisplayName: string;
  note: string | null;
  status: RequestStatus;
  closeReason: RequestCloseReason | null;
  claimedByUserId: string | null;
  claimedByDisplayName: string | null;
  claimedAt: string | null;
  reopenedAt: string | null;
  lastRebroadcastAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  requestRevision: string;
  displayOrder: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type RequestRevision = bigint;

export const requestTransitionMatrix: Record<RequestStatus, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.completed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.claimed,
    RequestStatus.withdrawn
  ]),
  [RequestStatus.withdrawn]: new Set<RequestStatus>([]),
  [RequestStatus.completed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([])
};

export const actionToAllowedStatuses: Record<ActionType, ReadonlySet<RequestStatus>> = {
  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),
  [ActionType.accept]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

export function canTransition(from: RequestStatus, to: RequestStatus): boolean {
  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);
}

export function canActorTakeAction(status: RequestStatus, action: ActionType): boolean {
  return actionToAllowedStatuses[action].has(status);
}

export interface RequestStateTransition {
  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;
}

export function transitionRequest(
  request: Request,
  nextStatus: RequestStatus,
  context: {
    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;
    now: string;
    actorId: string;
    closeReason?: RequestCloseReason;
  }
): RequestStateTransition {
  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid request status transition: ${request.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }

  return {
    request: {
      ...request,
      status: nextStatus,
      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,
      reopenedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.reopened ? context.now : request.reopenedAt,
      closeReason:
        nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn
          ? context.closeReason ?? request.closeReason
          : nextStatus === RequestStatus.completed
            ? null
            : request.closeReason,
      claimedByUserId: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.actorId : request.claimedByUserId,
      claimedByDisplayName: request.claimedByDisplayName,
      lastRebroadcastAt: request.lastRebroadcastAt,
      note: request.note
    },
    nextStatus,
    reason: nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn ? (context.closeReason ?? RequestCloseReason.requesterWithdrawn) : undefined
  };
}

      result: 'conflict',
      code: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,

    return;

async function deletedActorsFor(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {
    return new Set<string>();
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeletedActorRow>('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])', [ids]);
  const deleted = new Set<string>();

  for (const row of result.rows) {
    if (row.deleted_at !== null) {
      deleted.add(row.id);
    }
  }

  return deleted;
}

  const actor = req.actor;

  return actor;
}

export async function getRequest(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order,
            note, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'request_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const member = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (member.rows.length === 0) {
---
  if (member.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const scope = await deletedActorsFor([request.requester_id]);
  if (request.claimed_by_user_id) {
    scope.add(request.claimed_by_user_id);
  }

  res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(request, scope));
}

export async function getReceipt(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    'SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason, claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at, last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, note, created_at FROM requests WHERE id = $1',
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'request_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const receiptResult = await pool.query<DbReceiptRow>(
    'SELECT id, request_id, pod_name, requester_name, accepter_name, requested_at, accepted_at, completed_at, is_shareable_projection FROM receipts WHERE request_id = $1',
    [requestId]
  );

  if (receiptResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'receipt_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  res.status(200).json(toReceiptResponse(receiptResult.rows[0]));
}

  id: string;
  name: string;
  creator_id: string;
  created_by: string;
  home_timezone: string;
  member_count: number;
  join_code: string | null;
  created_at: string;

interface JoinCodeRow {
  code: string;

const CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 12;

function createCandidateCode(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(8);
  const alphabet = '[REDACTED:high_entropy]';
  let value = '';

  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
    value += alphabet[bytes[index] % alphabet.length];
  }

  return value;
}

async function nextAvailableCode(): Promise<string> {
  const pool = getPool();
  let attempt = 0;

  while (attempt < CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    const candidate = createCandidateCode();
    const existing = await pool.query<JoinCodeRow>('SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE code = $1', [candidate]);

    if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
      return candidate;
    }

    attempt += 1;
  }

  throw new Error('join_code_generation_exhausted');
}

function toPod(row: PodRow): Pod {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    creatorId: row.creator_id,
    homeTimezone: row.home_timezone,
    joinCode: row.join_code ?? '',
    joinCodeStatus: 'active',
    memberCount: row.member_count,
    createdBy: row.created_by,
    createdAt: row.created_at
  };
}

export async function rotateJoinCode(podId: string, actorId: string): Promise<Pod> {
  const pool = getPool();

  const podResult = await pool.query<PodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            p.created_at,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('pod_not_found');
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  if (!isCreator(toPod(pod), actorId)) {
    throw new Error('forbidden');
  }

  const nextCode = await nextAvailableCode();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_join_codes
          SET status = 'revoked', rotated_at = NOW()
        WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status = 'active'`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_join_codes (id, pod_id, code, status, created_at)

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1', [podId]);
    await client.query('COMMIT');

    return {
      ...toPod(pod),
      joinCode: nextCode
    };
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {

  } catch {

  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  return {

    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),

export async function listOpenRequests(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const podId = req.params.podId;
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1
        AND status IN ('open', 'claimed', 'reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<{ max_revision: string }>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const safeRevision = Number(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision ?? 0);
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows.rows) {
    actorIds.add(row.requester_id);
    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }
  }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds));
  const mappedRows = requestRows.rows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedActors));

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: {
      id: pod.id,
      name: pod.name,
      homeTimezone: pod.home_timezone,
      memberCount: pod.member_count,
      joinCode: pod.join_code ?? '',
      joinCodeStatus: 'active',
      createdBy: pod.created_by
    } as PodResponse,
    requests: mappedRows,
    boardRevision: safeRevision,
    serverNowUtc: new Date().toISOString()
  } as const);
}

    return BigInt(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const normalized = raw.trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
      return null;
    }
    return BigInt(normalized);
  }

  return null;
}

function conflictCodeFor(action: ActionType, request: DbRequestRow, actorId: string): ConflictCode {
  if (action === 'accept') {
    if (request.status === 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed;
    }
    if (request.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn;
    }
    if (request.status === 'completed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    if (request.status === 'reopened') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'reBroadcast') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
  }

  return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
}

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podTimezone: string
): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(request.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests

  );

  const now = new Date();

  if (action === 'accept') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: precheck === CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed ? precheck : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

async function applyAction(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  podTimezone: string,
  action: ActionType,
  actor: { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string },
  expectedRequestRevision: string

  if (action === 'accept') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: precheck === CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed ? precheck : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

       SET status = 'claimed', claimed_by_user_id = $2, claimed_by_display_name = $3,
            claimed_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq'),
             expires_at = $5
       WHERE id = $1
         AND request_revision = $4::bigint
         AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')

                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, expectedRequestRevision, computeDefaultExpiryUtc(now, podTimezone).toISOString()]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyPodMembers(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' },
      actor.userId
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

      return { conflictCode: precheck };

      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_withdrawn' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'completed', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')

    );

    }

      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_completed' },
      [request.requester_id, request.claimed_by_user_id]
    );

    return { request: completed };
  }

  const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
  if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
    return { conflictCode: precheck };
  }

  if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
  }
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
  }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
       SET last_rebroadcast_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
     WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint

}

async function resolveDeletedUsers(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {

  const result = await pool.query<DbPodMemberDeletedRow>(
    'SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])',

  return membership.rows.length > 0;
}

function buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool: ReturnType<typeof getPool>, requestRows: DbRequestRow[]): Promise<RequestResponse[]> {
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows) {

export async function createPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const name = String(req.body?.name ?? '').trim();
  const timezone = String(req.body?.timezone ?? '').trim();

  if (!name || !timezone) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_name_or_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    assertTimezone(timezone);
  } catch {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const podId = randomUUID();

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pods (id, name, creator_id, home_timezone, member_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0, $3, NOW(), NOW())`,
      [podId, name, actor.userId, timezone]
    );

    await createFreshJoinCodeForPod(client, podId);

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_memberships (id, pod_id, user_id, display_alias, is_creator, joined_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, TRUE, NOW(), 'active')`,
      [randomUUID(), podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias]
    );

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET member_count = member_count + 1 WHERE id = $1', [podId]);

    const podResult = await client.query<DbPodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
              (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
         FROM pods p WHERE p.id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
      res.status(500).json({ reason: 'pod_readback_failed' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(200).json(toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'create_pod_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

export async function revokeJoinCodeForPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const pod = await revokeJoinCode(podId, actor.userId);
    res.status(200).json(pod);
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = (error as Error).message;
    if (reason === 'forbidden') {
      res.status(403).json({ reason: 'forbidden' });
      return;
    }
    if (reason === 'pod_not_found') {
      res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
      return;
    }
    res.status(500).json({ reason: reason || 'revoke_join_code_failed' });
  }
}

export async function fetchPodState(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND status IN ('open','claimed','reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<RequestStateRow>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const requests = await buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool, requestRows.rows);

  const serverNow = podNowUtc(podResult.rows[0].home_timezone).toISOString();

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]),
    requests,
    boardRevision: Number(boardNowRequestRevision(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision)),
    serverNowUtc: serverNow
  });
}

function boardNowRequestRevision(raw: string | undefined): string {
  return raw ?? '0';
}

export async function postRequestInPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const podId = String(req.params.podId ?? '').trim();
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = parseClientActionId(req.body?.clientActionId);
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_client_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const note = req.body?.note ? String(req.body.note).trim() : null;
  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podRow = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    'SELECT id, home_timezone, name, creator_id, created_by, member_count FROM pods WHERE id = $1',
    [podId]
  );
  if (podRow.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const duplicate = await pool.query<ActionLogRow>(
    `SELECT id, request_id, request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot
       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,
    [actor.userId, clientActionId]
  );

  if (duplicate.rows.length > 0) {
    const existing = duplicate.rows[0];
    if (existing.outcome === 'applied' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      const request = toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id]));
      res.status(200).json(request);
      return;
    }

    if (existing.outcome === 'conflict' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        currentState: toRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot, await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.result_snapshot.requester_id])),
        code: existing.conflict_code ?? 'staleRevision',
        outcome: 'conflict'
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action', requestId: existing.request_id });
    return;
  }

  const podTimezone = podRow.rows[0].home_timezone;
  const expiresAtUtc = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(new Date(), podTimezone);

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const requestId = randomUUID();
    const requestResult = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `INSERT INTO requests (
         id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status,
         claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at, last_rebroadcast_at,
         expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'open', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, $6, NOW(), DEFAULT, NOW())
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [requestId, podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, note, expiresAtUtc.toISOString()]
    );

    if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('request_not_created');
    }

    const created = requestResult.rows[0];
    const requestRevisionBefore = Number(created.request_revision) > 0 ? Number(created.request_revision) - 1 : 0;
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO request_action_log (
         id, user_id, request_id, action_id, action_type,
         request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot, created_at
       ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'post', $5, $6, 'applied', NULL, $7::jsonb, NOW())`,
      [
        randomUUID(),
        actor.userId,
        requestId,
        clientActionId,
        String(requestRevisionBefore),
        created.request_revision,
        JSON.stringify(created)
      ]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');

    await notifyPodMembers({ requestId: created.id, podId, eventType: 'request_posted' }, actor.userId);

    res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(created, await resolveDeletedUsers([created.requester_id])));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    if ((error as { code?: string }).code === '23505') {
      const repeated = await pool.query<{ request_id: string | null }>(
        'SELECT request_id FROM request_action_log WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1',
        [actor.userId, clientActionId]
      );
      if (repeated.rows.length > 0 && repeated.rows[0].request_id) {
        const existing = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
          `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
                  claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                  last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
             FROM requests WHERE id = $1`,
          [repeated.rows[0].request_id]
        );
        if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
          const request = toRequestResponse(existing.rows[0], await resolveDeletedUsers([existing.rows[0].requester_id]));
          res.status(200).json(request);
          return;
        }
      }

      res.status(409).json({ reason: 'duplicate_action' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'request_post_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

const CONFLICT_CODES = {

function parseActionType(raw: unknown): ActionType | null {

  return null;

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): bigint | null {
  if (typeof raw === 'bigint') {
    return raw;
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isInteger(raw) && raw >= 0) {
    return BigInt(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {

  return null;

async function resolveDeletedActors(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {

async function toMaskedRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow): Promise<{

  requesterId: string;
  requesterDisplayName: string;

  closeReason: string | null;

    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName: deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name,
    note: row.note,

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podTimezone: string
): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return null;
  }

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(request.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {
    return null;
  }

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
        SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'autoExpired', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
      WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
      RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [request.id]
  );

  return expiredUpdate.rows[0] ?? null;
}

  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  acceptedAt: Date,
  completedAt: Date
): Promise<void> {
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO receipts (id, request_id, pod_name, requester_name, accepter_name, requested_at, accepted_at, completed_at, is_shareable_projection)
       SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, requests.created_at, $6, $7, TRUE
         FROM requests
        WHERE id = $2
        ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING`,
    [
      randomUUID(),
      request.id,
      podName,
      request.requester_display_name,
      request.claimed_by_display_name,
      acceptedAt.toISOString(),
      completedAt.toISOString()
    ]
  );
}

  expectedRequestRevision: string

    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {

    }

      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' },
      actor.userId

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };

  if (action === 'release') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
