    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };

       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'

      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,

    }

  }

  if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
  }

    return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(

       AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')

}

export async function acceptRequest(req: ActorRequest & { body: ActionBody }, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const actionType = parseActionType(req.body?.actionType);
  if (!actionType) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_action_type' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = String(req.body?.clientActionId ?? '').trim();
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevision = parseExpectedRevision(req.body?.expectedRequestRevision);
  if (expectedRevision === null) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_or_invalid_expected_revision' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevisionString = expectedRevision.toString();
  const pool = getPool();

  const existingLog = await loadActionLog(pool, actor.userId, clientActionId);
  if (existingLog) {
    if (existingLog.outcome === 'applied' && existingLog.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: toRequestResponse(existingLog.result_snapshot)
      });
      return;
    }

    const snapshot = existingLog.result_snapshot;
    if (snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        outcome: 'conflict',
        result: 'conflict',
        currentState: toRequestResponse(snapshot),
        code: existingLog.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
        requestId
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({
      outcome: 'conflict',
      result: 'conflict',
      code: existingLog.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      requestId
    });
    return;
  }

  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: expectedRevisionString,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      snapshot: null
    });

    res.status(409).json({ outcome: 'conflict', result: 'conflict', code: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown, requestId });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized,
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized));
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    'SELECT id, name, home_timezone FROM pods WHERE id = $1',
    [request.pod_id]
  );
  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  if (!pod) {
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.unknown));
    return;
  }

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const autoExpired = await maybeAutoExpireRequest(client, request, pod.home_timezone);
    if (autoExpired) {
      await writeActionLog(pool, {
        userId: actor.userId,
        requestId: autoExpired.id,
        actionId: clientActionId,
        actionType,
        requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
        requestRevisionAfter: autoExpired.request_revision,
        outcome: 'conflict',
        conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.expired,
        snapshot: autoExpired
      });
      await client.query('COMMIT');
      res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(autoExpired, CONFLICT_CODES.expired));
      return;
    }

    const attempt = await applyAction(client, request, pod.name, pod.home_timezone, actionType, actor, expectedRevisionString);

    if (attempt.request) {
      await writeActionLog(pool, {
        userId: actor.userId,
        requestId: request.id,
        actionId: clientActionId,
        actionType,
        requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
        requestRevisionAfter: attempt.request.request_revision,
        outcome: 'applied',
        conflictCode: null,
        snapshot: attempt.request
      });

      await client.query('COMMIT');
      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: toRequestResponse(attempt.request)
      });
      return;
    }

    const conflictCode = attempt.conflictCode ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown;
    await writeActionLog(pool, {
      userId: actor.userId,
      requestId: request.id,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      actionType,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode,
      snapshot: request
    });

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    res.status(409).json(buildConflictPayload(request, conflictCode));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'accept_request_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

});

  const nearNoonLocal = new Date('2025-01-01T23:10:00.000Z');

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podTimezone: string
): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return null;
  }

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(request.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {
    return null;
  }

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
        SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'autoExpired', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
      WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
      RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [request.id]
  );

  return expiredUpdate.rows[0] ?? null;
}

  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  acceptedAt: Date,
  completedAt: Date
): Promise<void> {
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO receipts (id, request_id, pod_name, requester_name, accepter_name, requested_at, accepted_at, completed_at, is_shareable_projection)
       SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, requests.created_at, $6, $7, TRUE
         FROM requests
        WHERE id = $2
        ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING`,
    [
      randomUUID(),
      request.id,
      podName,
      request.requester_display_name,
      request.claimed_by_display_name,
      acceptedAt.toISOString(),
      completedAt.toISOString()
    ]
  );
}

  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podName: string,
  podTimezone: string,
  action: ActionType,
  actor: { userId: string; firstNameAlias: string },
  expectedRequestRevision: string
): Promise<{ request?: DbRequestRow; conflictCode?: ConflictCode }> {
  const now = new Date();

  if (action === 'accept') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: precheck === CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed ? precheck : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

  const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
       SET status = 'claimed', claimed_by_user_id = $2, claimed_by_display_name = $3,
            claimed_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq'),
             expires_at = $5
       WHERE id = $1
         AND request_revision = $4::bigint
         AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias, expectedRequestRevision, computeDefaultExpiryUtc(now, podTimezone).toISOString()]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyPodMembers(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_accepted' },
      actor.userId
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'reopened', claimed_by_user_id = NULL, claimed_by_display_name = NULL,
             claimed_at = NULL, reopened_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_reopened' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'requesterWithdrawn', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened') AND requester_id = $2
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_withdrawn' },
      [request.requester_id]
    );

    return { request: updated.rows[0] };
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
    if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
      return { conflictCode: precheck };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
    }
    if (request.claimed_by_user_id !== actor.userId) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
    }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'completed', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint AND claimed_by_user_id = $2 AND status = 'claimed'
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
    }

    const completed = updated.rows[0];
    const acceptedAt = request.claimed_at ? new Date(request.claimed_at) : new Date();
    const completedAt = now;

    await ensureReceiptForCompletion(client, completed, podName, acceptedAt, completedAt);
    await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
      { requestId: request.id, podId: request.pod_id, eventType: 'request_completed' },
      [request.requester_id, request.claimed_by_user_id]
    );

    return { request: completed };
  }

  const precheck = conflictCodeFor(action, request, actor.userId);
  if (precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen && precheck !== CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized) {
    return { conflictCode: precheck };
  }

  if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized };
  }
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return { conflictCode: request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen };
  }

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
       SET last_rebroadcast_at = NOW(), request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
     WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $3::bigint
       AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
               claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
               last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [request.id, actor.userId, expectedRequestRevision]
    );

  if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
    return { conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision };
  }

  const updatedRequest = updated.rows[0];
  await notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
    { requestId: updatedRequest.id, podId: updatedRequest.pod_id, eventType: 'request_rebroadcast' },
    [updatedRequest.requester_id, updatedRequest.claimed_by_user_id ?? '']
  );

  return { request: updatedRequest };
}

export async function acceptRequest(req: ActorRequest & { body: ActionBody }, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

    });
    return;
  }

  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    await logAction(pool, {
      actorUserId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      requestRevisionBefore: expectedRevision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      actionType: 'withdraw',
      snapshot: null
    });

    res.status(409).json({
      outcome: 'conflict',
      result: 'conflict',
      code: CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      requestId
    });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];

  const member = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (member.rows.length === 0) {
    await logAction(pool, {
      actorUserId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized,
      actionType: 'withdraw',
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json({
      outcome: 'conflict',
      result: 'conflict',
      currentState: requestConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized).currentState,
      code: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized
    });
    return;
  }

  if (request.requester_id !== actor.userId) {
    await logAction(pool, {
      actorUserId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized,
      actionType: 'withdraw',
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json(requestConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized));
    return;
  }

  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    const code = request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    await logAction(pool, {
      actorUserId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: null,
      outcome: 'conflict',
      conflictCode: code,
      actionType: 'withdraw',
      snapshot: request
    });

    res.status(409).json(requestConflictPayload(request, code));
    return;
  }

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const updated = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
      `UPDATE requests
         SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'requesterWithdrawn', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
       WHERE id = $1 AND request_revision = $2::bigint AND status IN ('open', 'reopened') AND requester_id = $3
       RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                 claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                 last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
      [requestId, expectedRevision, actor.userId]
    );

    if (updated.rows.length === 0) {
      await logAction(pool, {
        actorUserId: actor.userId,
        requestId,
        actionId: clientActionId,
        requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
        requestRevisionAfter: null,
        outcome: 'conflict',
        conflictCode: CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision,
        actionType: 'withdraw',
        snapshot: request
      });

      await client.query('COMMIT');
      res.status(409).json(requestConflictPayload(request, CONFLICT_CODES.staleRevision));
      return;
    }

    const updatedRequest = updated.rows[0];

    await logAction(pool, {
      actorUserId: actor.userId,
      requestId,
      actionId: clientActionId,
      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: updatedRequest.request_revision,
      outcome: 'applied',
      conflictCode: null,
      actionType: 'withdraw',
      snapshot: updatedRequest
    });

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    res.status(200).json({
      outcome: 'applied',
      result: 'applied',
      request: toRequestResponse(updatedRequest)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'cancel_request_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  return new Date();
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, _podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(_podTimezone);
  return new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

export function newAuditToken(): string {
  return randomUUID();
}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { Response } from 'express';
import { getPool } from '../db';

interface ActorRequest {
  actor?: {
    userId: string;
    firstNameAlias: string;
  };
}

interface DbRequestRow {
  id: string;
  pod_id: string;
  requester_id: string;
  requester_display_name: string;
  status: 'open' | 'claimed' | 'reopened' | 'withdrawn' | 'completed';
  close_reason: string | null;
  claimed_by_user_id: string | null;
  claimed_by_display_name: string | null;
  claimed_at: string | null;
  reopened_at: string | null;
  last_rebroadcast_at: string | null;
  note: string | null;
  expires_at: string;
  request_revision: string;
  display_order: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface DbActionLogRow {
  id: string;
  request_id: string | null;
  request_revision_before: string;
  request_revision_after: string | null;
  outcome: 'applied' | 'conflict' | 'duplicate';
  conflict_code: string | null;
  result_snapshot: DbRequestRow | null;
}

interface DbAccountRow {
  id: string;
  deleted_at: string | null;
}

const CONFLICT_CODES = {
  alreadyClaimed: 'alreadyClaimed',
  notOpen: 'notOpen',
  staleRevision: 'staleRevision',
  withdrawn: 'withdrawn',
  expired: 'expired',
  unauthorized: 'unauthorized',
  duplicateAction: 'duplicateAction',
  unknown: 'unknown'
} as const;

type ConflictCode = keyof typeof CONFLICT_CODES;

interface RequestResponse {
  id: string;
  podId: string;
  requesterId: string;
  requesterDisplayName: string;
  note: string | null;
  status: string;
  closeReason: string | null;
  claimedByUserId: string | null;
  claimedByDisplayName: string | null;
  claimedAt: string | null;
  reopenedAt: string | null;
  lastRebroadcastAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  requestRevision: number;
  displayOrder: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

async function resolveDeletedActors(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {
    return new Set<string>();
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DbAccountRow>(
    'SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])',
    [ids]
  );

  const deleted = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    if (row.deleted_at !== null) {
      deleted.add(row.id);
    }
  }

  return deleted;
}

function validateActor(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): { userId: string } | null {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return null;
  }
  return actor;
}

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isInteger(raw) && raw >= 0) {
    return String(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'bigint' && raw >= 0n) {
    return raw.toString();
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const normalized = raw.trim();
    if (/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
      return normalized;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function toRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow): RequestResponse {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    podId: row.pod_id,
    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName: row.requester_display_name,
    note: row.note,
    status: row.status,
    closeReason: row.close_reason,
    claimedByUserId: row.claimed_by_user_id,
    claimedByDisplayName: row.claimed_by_display_name,
    claimedAt: row.claimed_at,
    reopenedAt: row.reopened_at,
    lastRebroadcastAt: row.last_rebroadcast_at,
    expiresAt: row.expires_at,
    requestRevision: Number(row.request_revision),
    displayOrder: Number(row.display_order),
    createdAt: row.created_at
  };
}

function requestConflictPayload(request: DbRequestRow, code: ConflictCode) {
  return {
    outcome: 'conflict' as const,
    result: 'conflict' as const,
    currentState: toRequestResponse(request),
    code
  };
}

async function loadActionLog(pool: ReturnType<typeof getPool>, actorUserId: string, actionId: string): Promise<DbActionLogRow | null> {
  const result = await pool.query<DbActionLogRow>(
    `SELECT id, request_id, request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot
       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,

async function toMaskedRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow): Promise<RequestResponse> {
  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedActors(
    [row.requester_id, ...(row.claimed_by_user_id ? [row.claimed_by_user_id] : [])]
  );

  return {
    id: row.id,
    podId: row.pod_id,
    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName: deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name,
    note: row.note,
    status: row.status,

    reopenedAt: row.reopened_at,
    lastRebroadcastAt: row.last_rebroadcast_at,
    expiresAt: row.expires_at,
    requestRevision: Number(row.request_revision),
    displayOrder: Number(row.display_order),
    createdAt: row.created_at
  };
}

async function requestConflictPayload(request: DbRequestRow, code: ConflictCode) {
  return {
    outcome: 'conflict' as const,
    result: 'conflict' as const,
    currentState: await toMaskedRequestResponse(request),
    code
  };
}

  actorUserId: string;
  requestId: string;
  actionId: string;
  requestRevisionBefore: string;
  requestRevisionAfter: string | null;

export async function cancelRequest(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = String(req.body?.clientActionId ?? '').trim();
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevision = parseExpectedRevision(req.body?.expectedRequestRevision);
  if (expectedRevision === null) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_or_invalid_expected_revision' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const existing = await loadActionLog(pool, actor.userId, clientActionId);

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, _podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(_podTimezone);
  return new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

  return randomUUID();

async function toMaskedRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow): Promise<{

  requesterId: string;
  requesterDisplayName: string;
  note: string | null;
  status: string;
  closeReason: string | null;
  claimedByUserId: string | null;
  claimedByDisplayName: string | null;
  claimedAt: string | null;
  reopenedAt: string | null;
  lastRebroadcastAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  requestRevision: number;
  displayOrder: number;
  createdAt: string;
}> {
  const actorIds = [row.requester_id];
  if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
    actorIds.push(row.claimed_by_user_id);
  }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedActors(actorIds);

  return {
    id: row.id,
    podId: row.pod_id,
    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName: deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name,

function conflictCodeFor(action: ActionType, request: DbRequestRow, actorId: string): ConflictCode {
  if (action === 'accept') {
    if (request.status === 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed;
    }
    if (request.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn;
    }
    if (request.status === 'completed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    if (request.status === 'reopened') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'reBroadcast') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
  }

  return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
}

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id

  );

    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,

    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;

       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1
        AND status IN ('open', 'claimed', 'reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,

  );

    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const safeRevision = Number(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision ?? 0);
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows.rows) {
    actorIds.add(row.requester_id);
    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }
  }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds));
  const mappedRows = requestRows.rows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedActors));

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: {
      id: pod.id,
      name: pod.name,
      homeTimezone: pod.home_timezone,
      memberCount: pod.member_count,
      joinCode: pod.join_code ?? '',
      joinCodeStatus: 'active',
      createdBy: pod.created_by
    } as PodResponse,
    requests: mappedRows,
    boardRevision: safeRevision,
    serverNowUtc: new Date().toISOString()
  } as const);

  const pool = getPool();
  await pool.query(

     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
     ON CONFLICT (user_id)

      params.apnsToken,
      params.platform,
      params.deviceId ?? null
    ]
  );
}

async function loadPodDevices(podId: string): Promise<DeviceRow[]> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
       JOIN pod_memberships pm ON pm.user_id = pd.user_id
      WHERE pm.pod_id = $1
        AND pm.left_at IS NULL
        AND pm.status = 'active'`,
    [podId]
  );

  return result.rows;
}

  );
}

export async function notifyPodMembers(payload: PodNotificationPayload, excludeUserId: string): Promise<void> {
  const devices = await loadPodDevices(payload.podId);
  const recipients = devices.filter((device) => device.user_id !== excludeUserId);

  await Promise.all(recipients.map((device) => fakePush(device, payload)));
}

export async function notifyRequestPosterOrAccepter(
  payload: PodNotificationPayload,
  watchedUserIds: string[]
): Promise<void> {
  const uniqueIds = [...new Set(watchedUserIds.filter((userId) => Boolean(userId)))];
  if (uniqueIds.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
      WHERE pd.user_id = ANY($1::uuid[])`,
    [uniqueIds]
  );

  const unique: Record<string, DeviceRow> = {};
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    unique[row.user_id] = row;
  }

  await Promise.all(Object.values(unique).map((device) => fakePush(device, payload)));
}

async function maybeAutoExpireRequest(
  client: Parameters<ReturnType<typeof getPool>['connect']>[0],
  request: DbRequestRow,
  podTimezone: string
): Promise<DbRequestRow | null> {
  if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
    return null;
  }

  const expired = shouldAutoExpire(new Date(request.expires_at), podTimezone);
  if (!expired) {
    return null;
  }

  const expiredUpdate = await client.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `UPDATE requests
        SET status = 'withdrawn', close_reason = 'autoExpired', request_revision = nextval('requests_request_revision_seq')
      WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('open', 'reopened')
      RETURNING id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
                claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
                last_rebroadcast_at, note, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at`,
    [request.id]
  );

  return expiredUpdate.rows[0] ?? null;
}

      requestRevisionBefore: request.request_revision,
      requestRevisionAfter: updatedRequest.request_revision,
      outcome: 'applied',

    client.release();
  }
}

import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { getPool } from './db';

/// Trivial numbered-.sql-file runner (DEC-project_plan-003): applies every
/// file in migrations/ in filename order, inside one transaction each. Every
/// statement in those files uses IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE, so this
/// is safe to re-run from an empty database or an already-migrated one.
/// No migration framework, no up/down pairs — that's an explicit
/// simplification for v1, not an oversight.
async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const migrationsDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
  const files = readdirSync(migrationsDir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.sql'))
    .sort();

  const pool = getPool();
  for (const file of files) {
    const sql = readFileSync(join(migrationsDir, file), 'utf8');
    console.log(`[migrate] applying ${file}`);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(sql);
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      console.error(`[migrate] failed on ${file}:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }
  console.log(`[migrate] done — applied ${files.length} file(s).`);
}

migrate()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch(() => process.exit(1));

export async function createPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const name = String(req.body?.name ?? '').trim();
  const timezone = String(req.body?.timezone ?? '').trim();

  if (!name || !timezone) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_name_or_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    assertTimezone(timezone);
  } catch {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const podId = randomUUID();

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pods (id, name, creator_id, home_timezone, member_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0, $3, NOW(), NOW())`,
      [podId, name, actor.userId, timezone]
    );

    await createFreshJoinCodeForPod(client, podId);

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_memberships (id, pod_id, user_id, display_alias, is_creator, joined_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, TRUE, NOW(), 'active')`,
      [randomUUID(), podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias]
    );

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET member_count = member_count + 1 WHERE id = $1', [podId]);

    const podResult = await client.query<DbPodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
              (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
         FROM pods p WHERE p.id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
      res.status(500).json({ reason: 'pod_readback_failed' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(200).json(toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'create_pod_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

interface ActorRequest {

interface DbRequestRow {

async function resolveDeletedActors(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {

  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DbAccountRow>(
    'SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])',

  for (const row of result.rows) {

  return actor;

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): string | null {

    return String(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'bigint' && raw >= 0n) {
    return raw.toString();
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {

    if (/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
      return normalized;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import { computeDefaultExpiryUtc, podLocalParts, podNowUtc, samePodCalendarDay } from './time_util';

test('computeDefaultExpiryUtc is a fixed UTC duration and independent of the server host timezone', () => {
  const podTimezone = 'America/New_York';
  const issuedAt = new Date('2025-03-09T04:00:00.000Z');
  const expiry = computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt, podTimezone);

  const expected = new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + 5 * 60 * 1000);
  assert.equal(expiry.toISOString(), expected.toISOString());
});

test('samePodCalendarDay uses pod timezone for day boundaries, not host timezone', () => {
  const source = new Date('2025-01-01T00:10:00.000Z');
  const nearNoonLocal = new Date('2025-01-01T23:10:00.000Z');

  // In America/New_York both instants are the same local day.
  assert.equal(samePodCalendarDay(source, nearNoonLocal, 'America/New_York'), true);

  // In Asia/Kolkata the same pair crosses calendar day.
  assert.equal(samePodCalendarDay(source, nearNoonLocal, 'Asia/Kolkata'), false);
});

test('podLocalParts exposes pod-local components for arbitrary valid times', () => {
  const podTimezone = 'America/Los_Angeles';
  const instant = new Date('2025-11-02T09:17:30.000Z');
  const parts = podLocalParts(instant, podTimezone);

  assert.equal(typeof parts.year, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.month, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.day, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.hour, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.minute, 'number');
  assert.equal(typeof parts.second, 'number');
});

test('podLocalParts rejects invalid IANA timezone identifiers', () => {
  assert.throws(() => {
    podLocalParts(new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'), 'Not/A-Real/Zone');
  }, /invalid_timezone/);
});

test('podNowUtc validates tz input and returns a Date', () => {
  const tz = 'America/New_York';
  const hostNow = new Date();
  const podNow = podNowUtc(tz);
  const oneMinute = 60_000;

  assert.ok(podNow.getTime() >= hostNow.getTime() - oneMinute);
  assert.ok(podNow.getTime() <= hostNow.getTime() + oneMinute);

  assert.throws(() => {
    podNowUtc('Definitely/NotReal');
  }, /invalid_timezone/);
});

  unauthorized: 'unauthorized',

} as const;

type ConflictCode = keyof typeof CONFLICT_CODES;

async function resolveDeletedActors(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {
    return new Set<string>();
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DbAccountRow>(
    'SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])',

  );

  const deleted = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    if (row.deleted_at !== null) {
      deleted.add(row.id);
    }
  }

  return deleted;
}

function validateActor(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): { userId: string } | null {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return null;
  }
  return actor;
}

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isInteger(raw) && raw >= 0) {
    return String(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'bigint' && raw >= 0n) {
    return raw.toString();
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const normalized = raw.trim();
    if (/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
      return normalized;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

async function loadActionLog(pool: ReturnType<typeof getPool>, actorUserId: string, actionId: string): Promise<DbActionLogRow | null> {
  const result = await pool.query<DbActionLogRow>(
    `SELECT id, request_id, request_revision_before, request_revision_after, outcome, conflict_code, result_snapshot
       FROM request_action_log
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND action_id = $2
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1`,
    [actorUserId, actionId]
  );

  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
}

async function toMaskedRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow): Promise<RequestResponse> {
  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedActors(
    [row.requester_id, ...(row.claimed_by_user_id ? [row.claimed_by_user_id] : [])]
  );

  return {
    id: row.id,
    podId: row.pod_id,
    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName: deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name,
    note: row.note,
    status: row.status,
    closeReason: row.close_reason,
    claimedByUserId: row.claimed_by_user_id,
    claimedByDisplayName:

    claimedAt: row.claimed_at,
    reopenedAt: row.reopened_at,
    lastRebroadcastAt: row.last_rebroadcast_at,
    expiresAt: row.expires_at,
    requestRevision: Number(row.request_revision),
    displayOrder: Number(row.display_order),
    createdAt: row.created_at
  };
}

async function requestConflictPayload(request: DbRequestRow, code: ConflictCode) {
  return {

    result: 'conflict' as const,
    currentState: await toMaskedRequestResponse(request),

  };
}

  actorUserId: string;
  requestId: string;
  actionId: string;
  requestRevisionBefore: string;
  requestRevisionAfter: string | null;
  outcome: 'applied' | 'conflict' | 'duplicate';
  conflictCode: string | null;
  actionType: 'withdraw';
  snapshot: DbRequestRow | null;
}): Promise<void> {

      params.actorUserId,
      params.requestId,
      params.actionId,
      params.requestRevisionBefore,
      params.requestRevisionAfter,

      params.conflictCode,
      params.snapshot === null ? null : JSON.stringify(params.snapshot)

  );
}

export async function cancelRequest(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const clientActionId = String(req.body?.clientActionId ?? '').trim();
  if (!clientActionId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_action_id' });
    return;
  }

  const expectedRevision = parseExpectedRevision(req.body?.expectedRequestRevision);
  if (expectedRevision === null) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_or_invalid_expected_revision' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const existing = await loadActionLog(pool, actor.userId, clientActionId);
  if (existing) {
    if (existing.outcome === 'applied' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(200).json({
        outcome: 'applied',
        result: 'applied',
        request: await toMaskedRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot),
        requestId: existing.request_id
      });
      return;
    }

    if (existing.outcome === 'conflict' && existing.result_snapshot) {
      res.status(409).json({
        outcome: 'conflict',
        result: 'conflict',
        currentState: await toMaskedRequestResponse(existing.result_snapshot),
        code: existing.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(409).json({
      outcome: 'conflict',
      result: 'conflict',
      code: existing.conflict_code ?? CONFLICT_CODES.unknown,
      requestId: existing.request_id ?? requestId
    });
    return;
  }

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  return new Date();
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, _podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(_podTimezone);
  return new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

export function newAuditToken(): string {
  return randomUUID();
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;

export interface PodCalendarParts {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  second: number;
}

function assertIanaTimezone(timezone: string): void {
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: timezone });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`invalid_timezone:${timezone}`);
  }
}

function readParts(parts: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart[]): (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']) => number {
  return (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPart['type']): number => {
    const value = parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '0';
    return Number(value);
  };
}

export function podLocalParts(instant: Date, timezone: string): PodCalendarParts {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'numeric',
    day: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: 'numeric',
    second: 'numeric',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(instant);

  const pick = readParts(parts);

  return {
    year: pick('year'),
    month: pick('month'),
    day: pick('day'),
    hour: pick('hour'),
    minute: pick('minute'),
    second: pick('second')
  };
}

export function podNowUtc(podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  return new Date();
}

export function samePodCalendarDay(left: Date, right: Date, timezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(timezone);

  const leftParts = podLocalParts(left, timezone);
  const rightParts = podLocalParts(right, timezone);

  return leftParts.year === rightParts.year && leftParts.month === rightParts.month && leftParts.day === rightParts.day;
}

export function computeDefaultExpiryUtc(issuedAt: Date, _podTimezone: string): Date {
  assertIanaTimezone(_podTimezone);
  return new Date(issuedAt.getTime() + DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000);
}

export function shouldAutoExpire(expiresAtUtc: Date, podTimezone: string): boolean {
  assertIanaTimezone(podTimezone);
  const nowUtc = new Date();
  if (nowUtc.getTime() >= expiresAtUtc.getTime()) {
    return true;
  }

  return !samePodCalendarDay(nowUtc, expiresAtUtc, podTimezone);
}

  return randomUUID();
}

export async function listOpenRequests(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const podId = req.params.podId;
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1
        AND status IN ('open', 'claimed', 'reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<{ max_revision: string }>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const safeRevision = Number(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision ?? 0);
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows.rows) {
    actorIds.add(row.requester_id);
    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }
  }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds));
  const mappedRows = requestRows.rows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedActors));

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: {
      id: pod.id,
      name: pod.name,
      homeTimezone: pod.home_timezone,
      memberCount: pod.member_count,
      joinCode: pod.join_code ?? '',
      joinCodeStatus: 'active',
      createdBy: pod.created_by
    } as PodResponse,
    requests: mappedRows,
    boardRevision: safeRevision,
    serverNowUtc: new Date().toISOString()
  } as const);
}

function parseActionType(raw: unknown): ActionType | null {
  if (raw === 'accept' || raw === 'release' || raw === 'withdraw' || raw === 'complete' || raw === 'reBroadcast') {
    return raw;
  }
  return null;
}

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): bigint | null {
  if (typeof raw === 'bigint') {
    return raw;
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isInteger(raw) && raw >= 0) {
    return BigInt(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const normalized = raw.trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
      return null;
    }
    return BigInt(normalized);
  }

  return null;
}

function conflictCodeFor(action: ActionType, request: DbRequestRow, actorId: string): ConflictCode {
  if (action === 'accept') {
    if (request.status === 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed;
    }
    if (request.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn;
    }
    if (request.status === 'completed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    if (request.status === 'reopened') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'reBroadcast') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
  }

  return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
}

function parseExpectedRevision(raw: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isInteger(raw) && raw >= 0) {
    return String(raw);
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'bigint' && raw >= 0n) {
    return raw.toString();
  }

  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const normalized = raw.trim();
    if (/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
      return normalized;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

async function toMaskedRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow): Promise<RequestResponse> {
  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedActors(

    requesterId: row.requester_id,
    requesterDisplayName: deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name,
    note: row.note,

export async function deleteAccount(userId: string): Promise<void> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const membershipResult = await client.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
      `SELECT pod_id
         FROM pod_memberships
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND left_at IS NULL
          AND status = 'active'`,
      [userId]
    );

    const activePodRows = membershipResult.rows;

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_memberships
          SET left_at = NOW(), status = 'revoked'
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND left_at IS NULL`,
      [userId]
    );

    for (const row of activePodRows) {
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE pods
            SET member_count = GREATEST(member_count - 1, 0)
          WHERE id = $1`,
        [row.pod_id]
      );
    }

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_device_tokens
          SET apns_token = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE user_id = $1`,
      [userId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE accounts
          SET deleted_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [userId]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

export async function getRequest(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const requestId = String(req.params.requestId ?? '').trim();
  if (!requestId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const requestResult = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order,
            note, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE id = $1`,
    [requestId]
  );

  if (requestResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'request_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const request = requestResult.rows[0];
  const member = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [request.pod_id, actor.userId]
  );

  if (member.rows.length === 0) {

    return;
  }

  const scope = await deletedActorsFor([request.requester_id]);
  if (request.claimed_by_user_id) {
    scope.add(request.claimed_by_user_id);
  }

  res.status(200).json(toRequestResponse(request, scope));
}

  [RequestStatus.open]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

  [RequestStatus.claimed]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

    RequestStatus.withdrawn,

  [RequestStatus.reopened]: new Set<RequestStatus>([

  ]),

  [ActionType.post]: new Set<RequestStatus>(),

    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.release]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.withdraw]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ]),
  [ActionType.complete]: new Set<RequestStatus>([RequestStatus.claimed]),
  [ActionType.reBroadcast]: new Set<RequestStatus>([
    RequestStatus.open,
    RequestStatus.reopened
  ])
};

  return requestTransitionMatrix[from].has(to);

  request: Request;
  nextStatus: RequestStatus;
  reason?: RequestCloseReason;

export function transitionRequest(
  request: Request,
  nextStatus: RequestStatus,
  context: {
    requestRevisionBefore: string;
    requestRevisionAfter: string;
    now: string;
    actorId: string;
    closeReason?: RequestCloseReason;
  }
): RequestStateTransition {
  if (!canTransition(request.status, nextStatus)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid request status transition: ${request.status} -> ${nextStatus}`);
  }

  return {
    request: {
      ...request,
      status: nextStatus,
      requestRevision: context.requestRevisionAfter,
      claimedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.now : request.claimedAt,
      reopenedAt: nextStatus === RequestStatus.reopened ? context.now : request.reopenedAt,
      closeReason:
        nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn
          ? context.closeReason ?? request.closeReason
          : nextStatus === RequestStatus.completed
            ? null
            : request.closeReason,
      claimedByUserId: nextStatus === RequestStatus.claimed ? context.actorId : request.claimedByUserId,
      claimedByDisplayName: request.claimedByDisplayName,
      lastRebroadcastAt: request.lastRebroadcastAt,
      note: request.note
    },
    nextStatus,
    reason: nextStatus === RequestStatus.withdrawn ? (context.closeReason ?? RequestCloseReason.requesterWithdrawn) : undefined
  };
}

  return memberships.some(
    (membership) =>
      membership.podId === podId &&
      membership.userId === userId &&
      membership.leftAtUtc === null &&
      membership.status === 'active'
  );
}

/// Receipt (post-fix) carries no child PII fields at all — there is nothing
/// left to scope out here. This still gates on active pod membership so a
/// caller who has left the pod (or was never in it) can't fetch a receipt
/// for a request they have no standing to see, per DEC-tech_specs-009's
/// "Receipt is a derived read-time view" model.
export function scopeReceiptForCaller(receipt: Receipt, memberships: PodMembership[], callerUserId: string, podId: string): Receipt | null {
  return isActivePodMember(podId, callerUserId, memberships) ? receipt : null;
}

export function scopeReceiptProjectionForCaller(
  receipt: Receipt,
  isMember: boolean
): ShareableReceiptProjection | null {
  return isMember ? toShareableProjection(receipt) : null;
}

export function scopeRequestForCaller(
  request: Request,
  memberships: PodMembership[],
  callerUserId: string
): Request {
  const allowed = memberships.some(
    (membership) =>
      membership.podId === request.podId &&
      membership.userId === callerUserId &&
      membership.leftAtUtc === null &&
      membership.status === 'active'
  );

  if (allowed) {
    return request;
  }

  return request;
}

export function resolveAccountName(account: Pick<Account, 'displayName' | 'deletedAt'>): string {
  return resolveDisplayName(account);
}

function conflictCodeFor(action: ActionType, request: DbRequestRow, actorId: string): ConflictCode {
  if (action === 'accept') {
    if (request.status === 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.alreadyClaimed;
    }
    if (request.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn;
    }
    if (request.status === 'completed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    if (request.status === 'reopened') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'release') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'withdraw') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'complete') {
    if (request.status !== 'claimed') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
    return request.claimed_by_user_id !== actorId ? CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
  }

  if (action === 'reBroadcast') {
    if (request.requester_id !== actorId) {
      return CONFLICT_CODES.unauthorized;
    }
    if (request.status !== 'open' && request.status !== 'reopened') {
      return request.status === 'withdrawn' ? CONFLICT_CODES.withdrawn : CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
    }
  }

  return CONFLICT_CODES.notOpen;
}

export async function listOpenRequests(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = req.actor;
  if (!actor) {
    res.status(401).json({ reason: 'unauthorized' });
    return;
  }

  const podId = req.params.podId;
  if (!podId) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_pod_id' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();

  const membership = await pool.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
    `SELECT pod_id
       FROM pod_memberships
      WHERE pod_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND left_at IS NULL AND status = 'active'`,
    [podId, actor.userId]
  );

  if (membership.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(403).json({ reason: 'not_a_member' });
    return;
  }

  const podResult = await pool.query<DbPodRow>(
    `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.home_timezone, p.created_by, p.member_count,
            (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
       FROM pods p
      WHERE p.id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ reason: 'pod_not_found' });
    return;
  }

  const pod = podResult.rows[0];
  const requestRows = await pool.query<DbRequestRow>(
    `SELECT id, pod_id, requester_id, requester_display_name, note, status, close_reason,
            claimed_by_user_id, claimed_by_display_name, claimed_at, reopened_at,
            last_rebroadcast_at, expires_at, request_revision, display_order, created_at
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1
        AND status IN ('open', 'claimed', 'reopened')
      ORDER BY display_order ASC`,
    [podId]
  );

  const boardRevisionResult = await pool.query<{ max_revision: string }>(
    `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(request_revision), 0) AS max_revision
       FROM requests
      WHERE pod_id = $1`,
    [podId]
  );

  const safeRevision = Number(boardRevisionResult.rows[0]?.max_revision ?? 0);
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows.rows) {
    actorIds.add(row.requester_id);
    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }
  }

  const deletedActors = await resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds));
  const mappedRows = requestRows.rows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedActors));

  res.status(200).json({
    pod: {
      id: pod.id,
      name: pod.name,
      homeTimezone: pod.home_timezone,
      memberCount: pod.member_count,
      joinCode: pod.join_code ?? '',
      joinCodeStatus: 'active',
      createdBy: pod.created_by
    } as PodResponse,
    requests: mappedRows,
    boardRevision: safeRevision,
    serverNowUtc: new Date().toISOString()
  } as const);
}

async function loadPodDevices(podId: string): Promise<DeviceRow[]> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DeviceRow>(
    `SELECT pd.user_id, pd.apns_token, pd.platform, pd.device_id
       FROM pod_device_tokens pd
       JOIN pod_memberships pm ON pm.user_id = pd.user_id
      WHERE pm.pod_id = $1

  );

export async function deleteAccount(userId: string): Promise<void> {
  const pool = getPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    const membershipResult = await client.query<{ pod_id: string }>(
      `SELECT pod_id
         FROM pod_memberships
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND left_at IS NULL
          AND status = 'active'`,
      [userId]
    );

    const activePodRows = membershipResult.rows;

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE pod_memberships
          SET left_at = NOW(), status = 'revoked'
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND left_at IS NULL`,
      [userId]
    );

    for (const row of activePodRows) {
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE pods
            SET member_count = GREATEST(member_count - 1, 0)
          WHERE id = $1`,
        [row.pod_id]
      );
    }

    await client.query(

      [userId]
    );

    await client.query(
      `UPDATE accounts
          SET deleted_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [userId]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_request_id' });
    return;

  const actionType = parseActionType(req.body?.actionType);
  if (!actionType) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_action_type' });
    return;

async function resolveDeletedUsers(ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) {

  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const result = await pool.query<DbPodMemberDeletedRow>(
    'SELECT id, deleted_at FROM accounts WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])',
    [ids]
  );

  const deleted = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    if (row.deleted_at !== null) {
      deleted.add(row.id);
    }
  }

  return deleted;

  );

  return membership.rows.length > 0;
}

function buildDeletedAwareSnapshot(pool: ReturnType<typeof getPool>, requestRows: DbRequestRow[]): Promise<RequestResponse[]> {
  const actorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of requestRows) {
    actorIds.add(row.requester_id);
    if (row.claimed_by_user_id) {
      actorIds.add(row.claimed_by_user_id);
    }
  }

  return resolveDeletedUsers(Array.from(actorIds)).then((deletedUsers) =>
    requestRows.map((row) => toRequestResponse(row, deletedUsers))
  );
}

export async function createPod(req: ActorRequest, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const actor = await validateActor(req, res);
  if (!actor) return;

  const name = String(req.body?.name ?? '').trim();
  const timezone = String(req.body?.timezone ?? '').trim();

  if (!name || !timezone) {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'missing_name_or_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    assertTimezone(timezone);
  } catch {
    res.status(400).json({ reason: 'invalid_timezone' });
    return;
  }

  const pool = getPool();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const podId = randomUUID();

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pods (id, name, creator_id, home_timezone, member_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0, $3, NOW(), NOW())`,
      [podId, name, actor.userId, timezone]
    );

    await createFreshJoinCodeForPod(client, podId);

    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO pod_memberships (id, pod_id, user_id, display_alias, is_creator, joined_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, TRUE, NOW(), 'active')`,
      [randomUUID(), podId, actor.userId, actor.firstNameAlias]
    );

    await client.query('UPDATE pods SET member_count = member_count + 1 WHERE id = $1', [podId]);

    const podResult = await client.query<DbPodRow>(
      `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creator_id, p.created_by, p.home_timezone, p.member_count,
              (SELECT code FROM pod_join_codes WHERE pod_id = p.id AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS join_code
         FROM pods p WHERE p.id = $1`,
      [podId]
    );

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    if (podResult.rows.length === 0) {
      res.status(500).json({ reason: 'pod_readback_failed' });
      return;
    }

    res.status(200).json(toPodResponse(podResult.rows[0]));
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    res.status(500).json({ reason: (error as Error).message ?? 'create_pod_failed' });
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

    if (count.rows[0]?.count !== '0') {

function toRequestResponse(row: DbRequestRow, deletedActors: Set<string>): RequestResponse {
  const requesterDisplayName = deletedActors.has(row.requester_id) ? 'Former member' : row.requester_display_name;
  const claimedByDisplayName = row.claimed_by_user_id && deletedActors.has(row.claimed_by_user_id)

    requesterDisplayName,
    note: row.note,

    claimedByDisplayName,
    claimedAt: row.claimed_at,
